reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: the most harsh grader ever.

Professor Putman is extremely focused on helping students succeed in MGMT 254! Her quizzes are extremely difficult; however, if you got to office hours she will always go through answers with you and help you prepare for the future! 

Please make sure to go to class!!! If you do the lectures are full of stories that make the concepts jump out!

The quizzes are straight out of the textbook, and you won't do well if you only attend lecture. You have to read and watch all of the videos if you want to pass. Good opportunities for extra credit and easy points through participation.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: attendance is marked, but you can miss a couple of classes. Class is straight forward.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects

reviews.comment: Prof. Putman is an extremely kind and genuine individual who really cares about the work she does. On top of that she provides many good real world examples of the content and helps to really drive home the impact that law has in business. I really enjoyed her class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Honestly, I think she was one of the best professors I've had at Purdue. I'm looking into TA-ing for her next year because I absolutely love the material she teaches, as well as her overall teaching style. Highly Recommend.

Cara is probably one of the most passionate professors I know. You can tell she puts a lot of effort into her lectures, and makes sure that each student understands the topic and whatever she is covering that day. She has great examples and tries to compare it to the real world as possible. It wasn't a lot of work; weekly quizzes and open note exam
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: At first Professor Putman was not my favorite. She's super bubbly and I'm not. I often see bubbly people as fake, but she's extremely genuine. She cares about her students and really tries to help her students retain the material.

Professor Putman is by far one of the best professors at Krannert. She ensures students understand the content and takes the time to connect with her students. I can't wait to take more of her classes in the future.

Prof Putman is a great professor to have. She makes her courses engaging and open to students interest. She has a fun way of teaching classes and does a good job catering to everyone. Would take again

It is clear how much Charlie not only loves his job, but loves other people. He showed genuine care for his students and clearly wanted everyone to succeed. My favorite moment was the line of students after our last lecture lining up to give him a hug, or just thank him. If you have to take SCLA102, take it with Charlie.

This is the first time ive really cared about an english/lit class in a long time. Charlie is inspirational and really cares about his students not only in his class, but going forward. Hes the type that will say hi if he sees you 2 years after you had him. Im bad at public speech, but hes a forgiving grader and gave me Bs on all my speeches.
Charlie is an incredible professor with genuine passion not just for what he teaches but for life in general

Professor Charlie has been the most passionate professor I have had at Purdue so far. It is clear that he cares about his work and the impact on students. He does a great job of bringing the real world into the classroom for deeper learning.

I wish that I could select more tags. This man is so kind and incredibly inspirational. I truly have learned so much about myself in his class. Every assignment is intentional and reasonable. I would recommend him to anyone and if you have to take a writing requirement, take him if you can! You won't regret it.
Professor Catalano is the most genuine, caring professor I have ever had. He truly wants the best for all his students, and oriented his course to help us find our own driving motivation.

Charlie has so much care and compassion for his students and wants each one of them to feel valued and gain something from the course, his course content is nuanced and interesting with semester themes that actually make the readings fun, and presentations are outlined very well. Outstanding teacher and amazing person
SCLA 102 entirely depends on your professor and Charlie is the reason I loved this class. He is so kind and truly cares about his students. If you can, take his class

Dr. Catalano is an amazing professor! He makes SCLA 102 fun, and classes have very high attendance due to this. The workload is very fair and many extra credit opportunities are offered throughout the semester. Highly recommend Dr. Catalano for this course.

Charlie was an incredible professor. Within the first week he learned all of the student's names and truly cared about our growth through the semester. All of the assignments had appropriate deadlines and were easy to complete. He helps students through speech anxiety and wants to inspire everyone daily. Books were cheap, and many extra options.

Very kind and caring professor and is very inspirational. His class is accessible, textbooks are very affordable (99 cents on kindle!) and the content is very easy to understand and complete. This class did not take much time out of my week. He is very understanding of anxiety during speeches and makes the room a calming place without judgement.

Charlie has to be hands down one of the best professors I have ever had. He works so hard to make sure his students feel supported, and is always cheering us on. I have never looked forward to going to a class more. One of the most caring professors in the world. I recommend you take a class by Charlie any chance you get!

Literally one of the best teachers let alone professors Ive ever had. We all cried on the last day of class. Super helpful and friendly and cares a lot about his students. His classes are an easy A so try and have fun!
One of the best profs I have met in Purdue!! We love him

One of the most caring professors I'll ever have. Gives instruction and feedback very effectively and makes his assignments actually useful. Makes a personal connection with students and treated us like equals. His class was an amazing change of pace from difficult lecture based classes where the professors don't care. 10/10 would take again.

One of the best professors I had. I was worried when I saw 102 was a speaking class as that is something I hate and actively avoid. However, he was the nicest and most caring person and would encourage you to try your best. His class was the highlight of my day and I wish I could take one of his courses again. A true heart of gold.

Literally the best professor I have ever had and it's his first year teaching. You need to take a class with Charlie. He's amazing and makes you feel welcomed and loved. He's one of those professors that calls students his children and that just goes to say that he really cares about his students. My whole class loved Charlie

Professor Harper was very nice and helped to wake you up bright and early. The class was fun, with many good team projects and some quizzes. She was a bit of a strict grader though, and the workload was a little much for a 1 credit class though.

One-credit course with quizzes based on the textbook and more. Independent studying was required, as not all quiz material was reviewed in class. Really strict grader, and way too much work for one-credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: She is seriously the best professor ever. She is extremely knowledgable and her lectures are very interesting. This class is not hard but lots of work outside of class.

One of the best professors I have ever had. I took this as an elective and would recommend to any student. She teaches very real-world scenarios that everyone should know about law, crime, and contracts, very applicable. She makes lectures fun, engaging, and is understanding about absences. A real lawyer, very good to learn from.

I had her for mgmt 255! Would recommend. She is very energetic and made the 7:30 am not so bad. She's very clear about expectations. Online quizzes were open book. Lots of work outside of class, more than a one credit should be, but not difficult.

Prof Harper is super sweet and genuinely wants you to do well. However this class is kind of a struggle since the majority of the content is not really covered in class and has to be learned through the textbook. Study for the final well in advance
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Harper's MGMT 254 is the most fun I have had in a class in college. The class is difficult, but Harper is always ready to help in anyway possible. She understands that there are things that go on outside of her classroom and is very respectful of her students time. The work is heavy but you are given a lot of time to complete it.

This class was very disorganized when I took it. She also would not respond to my emails on multiple occasions. Homework assignments are also disorganized, filled with spelling and grammatical errors as well as asking questions not covered in the book or slides, but are usually pretty easy. I had 3 midterms and a comprehensive final.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: this is my first rate my professors review because she's the greatest professor I've ever had. she's and amazing lecturer and its clear she loves what she does. she's funny and gets the whole class involved. participation is easy. there's only one exam which is not awesome but I def would take this prof again.
Very good, but 1 exam that makes or breaks your grade. Quizzes every friday, which are easy and open note. LOTS OF NOTE-TAKING.

I am an engineering student, so I took this course because the topic interested me on a surface level. Professor Harper is one of the best professors I have ever had. Her lectures are lively, and attendance is not mandatory but highly recommended. She makes the concepts easy to learn with activities. Thanks to her, I am considering law school.

Most of the class is spent with a mentor who is an undergrad student who has taken HDFS 100. Dr. Elias was nice and an easy grader. The whole class is projects. There are 3, which are all very easy, and have multiple parts. She gave a week by week schedule which was followed exactly so you always know what to expect when you go in.
I learned so much in this class. It is very participation oriented but it is not difficult at all. I would absolutely take it again!
Dr. Elias is one of the most caring and intelligent professors. I have taken 3 of her classes and she truly is one of the best!
Amazing professor. Had a wonderful time with her during my time in college.
She was a great prof and always found a way to make her class interesting. The class was really easy and there were only like 5 assignments. Just show up and you'll get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is a very good speaker and explainer. Problem stems from her slides. She gives slides with blanks to fill in during class. However, not every slide has a blank so you have to go back in the book to teach yourself later or take notes off what she says. She has random in class activities and Hot Seats so coming to class is important for credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Super nice professor and really fair grader. Attendance really matters in this class but I plan to take her classes again in the future.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I loved this class, but mainly because I'm really interested in the subject matter. Dr. Elias is a good teacher and an easy grader. Tests are pretty simple and all multiple choice. There is one paper but she grades it really easy so no sweat

Sexuality and Family Life with Dr. Elias is a great class. It is a mix of traditional lectures and guest speakers. The tests are very straight forward. A lot of the information is just expanding on high school health class. Dr. Elias truly cares about all of her students and makes adjustments in the course every semester based on feedback.

This class was very easy, however Professor Elias was often disorganized or unclear. Her study guides are not helpful and exams can be tough, but going to class and reading the book is really all you need to do well on the exams. Sometimes lectures are a bit boring, but she is overall friendly and there to help. Not a great professor, not terrible.

I have taken multiple classes with him, and from those I have figured out, he is a very unorganized professor. Moving around exams last minute, giving the wrong amount of time for test, not grading the homework, along with changing the syllabus or not providing one to follow. He has made many students drop out and retake under another professor.

He gives little to no feedback and when he does he phrases things extremely vaguely and to the point where you have no clue what he's actually saying. A lot of reading is needed. his organization skills are bad to say the least we had a full schedule planned only lasted 4 weeks. There are pop quizzes throughout the class that are you can't makeup.

It's just really clear that he has low regard for the humans that he teaches. He thinks we're unintelligent unless we fit his narrow ideals. It's an unfortunate atmosphere to be in. The real tragedy is he thinks he's so talented and correct that he'll never be open to feedback or changing his teaching style.

Not as bad as described, but expect late grading and unclear information on your grade, and surprise mini-quizzes that will contribute to a significant portion of said grade. If you actually do the reading and come to class on time, you'll do fine. Stress on the time bit since the quizzes are usually done in the first 2 minutes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: For a written communication course, it was harder than it had to be. Late graded assignments, not following the syllabus schedule, vague assignment descriptions, vague and unclear communication, one-size-fits-all teaching style, condescending attitude, and a few, if any, applicable constructive feedback on essays and written assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Initially a very tough professor but he gets nicer over time. Makes you really work for your grade on the essays but is easy with other assignments. He's very intimidating but not a bad teacher. He provided a lot of guidance for the final essay but the first one was basically us going in blind. Not impossible to get a good grade though.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's an ok professor. He's not great at teaching and he's not very friendly. Has very strict regulations but as long as you follow them and do a decent job you can get an A. Not really worth the hassle though.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Genuinely the most unorganized professor I've ever seen. He assigns work the day before it's due, not when class is in session. He also goes ballistic if you forget some material or are late or anything else but when it's time for him to grade or assign something he is ALWAYS late and unorganized. Also yells at you if you need to use the restroom.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Teaches in a monotonous manner. Barely gives feedback. Strict grading. Requires expensive textbooks.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I ended up getting a good grade in this class, but it was frustrating. The course could have been interesting, but Prof Campbell made it feel rigid. His approach is extremely narrow-minded; he seems to believe there is only one “correct” way to learn, participate, or even ask questions. This stifled real engagement or creative thinking.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Grading in this class was a nightmare. i barely got any feedback throughout the semester, and grades were only posted toward the end, leaving me no time to improve. Even when I did get feedback, it was rather condescending and didn't help me understand my  mistakes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was one of the most frustrating classes I've taken. Professor Cambell seems uninterested in teaching, which made learning impossible. lectures were disorganized & unclear, leaving students confused about important concepts. Instructions for assignments were vague, and when we asked for clarification, his explanations were just as confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Campbell's class was always a fun part of the semester. He tried to make lectures interesting and you can tell that he is passionate about the subject. There is quite a bit of reading but if you miss a couple of them it's not a big deal since he goes over the main structure of the story in class.

Campbell is a very caring professor and his class is very enjoyable. Attendance isn't mandatory, but the lectures help you to understand the reading more. Make sure to do the readings as they will be useful for the quizzes. The grade is made up of quizzes, exams, and an annotated article. Great class and quite enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's probably one of the better teachers I had. The class is pretty heavy on the writing aspect, but what do you expect, it is a written communication class. He gave me above a 90 on pretty much all my assignments. I didn't get an A because I forgot to bring a printed copy of my essay, which he did send an email as a reminder. Pretty great teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Hated this professor, did well in all my essays (above 90) but I still got a B because he gave a 0 on a homework assignment because he wanted a compare and contrast chart and i did compare and contrast chart and a mini essay (his example included an essay so i got confused) and then he got mad and gave me a zero saying i dont listen.

Dr. Campbell was a quirky teacher and I enjoyed his lectures. However, his grading was confusing/difficult. He takes a long time to grade everything, so I had no idea how I was doing in the class. He graded my last essay a lot easier than he graded the others either because he could see effort or because he rushed to get final grades in.

This professor procrastinates grading until the semester's end, leaving students clueless about their standing. Feedback is harsh, unhelpful, and lacks solutions. Their obsession with the subject makes it nearly impossible to succeed without matching their passion. They also speak poorly of students in other classes, creating a toxic environment.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Campbell is not a bad teacher, a lot of the assignments we do in class do help you succeed on your essays. He is though a pretty harsh grader and also takes extremely long to grade essays and release grades. You will most likely not know what you got on your essays until the end or middle of finals week.

It is like he has a personal grudge against every student he teaches. He does not make expectations clear in any way. When asking a question, he will most likely not answer it in any clear way. Understanding what he wants is harder than watching Purdue Football.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You will not know how you are doing in his course until it is too late. Takes a very long time to put essay grades in. Extends assignment deadlines often. Tough grader, says he loves to give A's but it is rare for him to give you an A on any assignment that is a huge chunk of your grade.

when you dont understand anything going on in class he belittles you. he does not grade things until weeks after completed. after grading he shames you on your writing when he doesnt agree with it. he isn't easy to talk to or ask questions to. dont miss any classes if you want to know anything going on or where to find hidden assignment information
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Campbell is quite rude and curt. While being demanding isn't necessarily a problem, the real issue lies in his lack of understanding of effective pedagogy. Instead of focusing on being an effective instructor, he tends to be very overbearing, which hampers the learning experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Campbell is the exemplar professor to teach languages. He recognizes all facets of language teaching, and strives to help his students comprehend completely. Though he may be tough on his students in class, if one attempts to reach out to him, he is extremely helpful and considerate. Every course I have taken with him has been amazing.

Attendance is super important to him, but also the course is inaccessible to students with disabilities who can't make it to class. Mountains and mountains of homework. He believes in language learning by ear. If you can't answer in Latin or have auditory processing issues, you will fail. If you can't do 4 HW assignments by next class, you fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: If at all possible, take anothe Professor. This person should not be in an education setting. The comments about making everyone uncomfortable are quite apt.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Take any other professor possible. Very harsh as a person and the comment about "boot camp" is very accurate. He is not a teacher that I felt comfortable asking for help. He was easily frustrated when material was not quickly understood to the point that students were embarrassed. Class was not a place that fostered the learning of new ideas.

The other comments about his apathy are true. He is however very proficient in Latin and if you want a sort of Latin BootCamp this is your go-to professor. He will push you pretty hard because of how strict his grading is, but as long as you stay consistent with the work you will most likely pass. Still definitely a fairly domineering professor.
I would avoid this professor at all costs. He runs his class in a very authoritarian way and does not give clear expectations. His syllabus isn't updated.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Not as bad as expected. A bit of work initially but after 2-3 weeks very minimal work besides reading (I just read sections of the books) and writing (only 3 essays ranging 3-7 pages for the semester). Super late grader as he didn't grade our 3 main papers until the end of the semester. He does offer help outside of lass and plenty of extra credit.

Thought I was getting an A, but the day grades were due, he graded assignments due months ago which lowered me 4%. Instructions given for assignments are unclear and the syllabus won't help due to it not being updated and not aligning with minimal information given to you in class. Avoid if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Very passionate about his subject, but to the point where he expects way too much out of his students. He will grade you very hard on an outline and expect you to know exactly how to remedy it. If you love English this class is perfect, but for anyone else I would stay clear.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Very apathetic
Emotionally inept.

If you don't care about reading you won't like this teacher. I started the year missing class, not doing any work, and destined to fail. He helped me get back on track, submit work weeks late, revise essays, and make it so if I put in the work I could pass. I was expecting to fail but he helped me get a B. Cares about his students deeply.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: He is very passionate about the texts he taught and was very knowledgeable. He is a tough grader and has very high expectations of his students. The classroom environment he creates feels like a dictatorship, and he forces everything to go perfectly. Feels like it's the 1920s. If you can get another prof for SCLA 101 do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Campbell was an amazing lecturer and is extremely passionate about classical studies. The quizzes were all pretty easy as long as you do the readings/attend lecture. If you miss a couple of the readings, don't stress because Professor Campbell will go over the reading material in class. If you attend lecture you may get EC from a quiz.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great person but tough grader when it comes to essays.
He has an apparent passion for the topic of mythology. His passion makes the students excited to learn. I would love to take a class from him again.

Awful professor, many of the good reviews here are written by himself. Evidently shown as when people put a bad review, a good review pops up the same week with stuff that is not true at all about him. Avoid this professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Campbell is a really nice guy and solid prof. He is always willing to help you if needed, and knows what he is talking about. He gives plenty of opportunities for extra credit. Only one complaint: I have no idea what my grade is in the class as he still has not graded anything major such as essays and its currently finals week.

Way too apathetic and harsh on grading. I would spend hours on his essays and he would basically want me to redo the whole thing. The essays were super complicated and were on boring books that made no sense at all. He's also very short tempered and got frustrated with mistakes or when people didn't know the answer to his questions. Easiest drop.
He is such a kind person and very engaging to watch. I dont ever feel bored and he relays information really well, on top of being very accessible and nice

Avoid this professor. He is a good person, but procrastinates on grading so no one knows their grade. His expectations are ridiculously high and he needs to understand that not everyone is passionate about greek mythology. He gets VERY mad when people do not understand his overly complicated questions and the confusing text rather than helping.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Campbell is a professor who is clearly very passionate about his interest in his profession. I thought his lectures were incredibly clear and interesting. The quizzes are a breeze as long as you pay attention in class, take notes, and read the assignments, which he makes mesh with the class very well. I really enjoyed this class.

This professor is a very passion, very interactive professor that will give you all the information he can for the quizzes and exams. There are no curveballs or anything like that because he thoroughly covers class material and provides plenty of resources for further studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I highly recommend going to every lecture and taking very good notes. While you'll be taking an in-person quiz/test every week, the questions can easily be answered by just participating in class. Campbell is extremely passionate about his curriculum and could talk for days about the subject, so sit back and let him stick to his lecturing material.
Awful professor. Didnt grade anything until finals week and by that time it was too late to learn from any mistakes on papers. Doesnt give rubrics to go off of just talks about what he wants done.

Campbell is the most enjoyable professor I've ever had. I took his 233 class for fun (spring '20 in person) and loved him so much I took his 235 class (fall '20 online). His lectures are fun and he really cares about his students. The only con is that reading/memorization are a huge factor for tests, but the content is interesting!

Campbell was one of the worst professors that I have had. On top of his apathy for DRC Paperwork, he openly mocked students in class and bullied students into dropping. His class compared to the one offered by a different professor were drastically different, ranging from him never teaching charts to the other prof explaining all materials

Professor Campbell is an amazing lecturer, I suggest you show up to class and listen to this guy talk about cool things like gods and demigods of the ancient worlds. He's very passionate about the subject he's teaching, and as for the exams, if you miss lectures, go over his notes and slides and a few readings and you're good.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This professor is great, she is very caring and is very helpful with all her students! There is quite a bit of group work (having to meet once a week) but it's nothing too overwhelming. The content is pretty easy and interesting to learn!

The class that I took isn't listed as an option (SPAN485), but MY FAVORITE PROFESSOR AT PURDUE. So sweet, caring, accommodating, clear grading criteria, FUNNY, extra credit opportunities. Gives lots of anecdotes from her country (Argentina) that gives me real world application to using the language. Also this was a cooking class! We made tamales!

I loved her. I have no complaints other than maybe the Brightspace set up. I hope to take classes with her in the future! Online was fairly easy other than sometimes forgetting to do the assignments, but I loved her and the class!

Tenorio is now my favorite Purdue professor. She is so incredibly knowledge in her field and keeps her lectures so incredibly interesting. Her feedback is so detailed and personalized that you really learn from your mistakes. Take this class! Take any class with her. She is like the abuela youve always wanted to teach you a spanish course.
She is a straight savage (in a good way). I have learned very much from her and am very glad to have taken her class.
Very good teacher, be prepared or she will prepare you for class.  She is organized, attentive, always open to help and will push you to achieve well.  She also has a slight Argentine accent.
Hot tamale!
Exceptional teacher, really knows her stuff.  Makes class really interesting and fun.
Overall confusing and frustrating to work with. I think she meant well but she generally didn't listen.

One of the worst people ever. Does this annoying where she puts in the wrong grade and then doesn't change it until weeks later. Doesn't create a comfortable environment but expects us to discuss sensitive topics like sexual relations. Shuts down students and forces them to conform to her ideals about feminism, patriarchy, and society.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is the worst professor at Purdue. Don't ever take her class. She interrupts students giving their presentations if they forget even the smallest thing. She doesn't give examples of the citations that she wants. She is really critical. I should have known this class was bad when she made us read our syllabus out loud on the first day.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you have any basic understanding of statistics prior to this course, you will do well. The homework assignments are long, but helpful towards the exams as the exact same topics will be covered, and most of the time in the same formats. Show up to every lecture because you take notes every lecture. Exams are very straight forward.
She gives off the same vibe as the "no pomegranates" teacher. If you don't know then look it up.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The people that like her are teachers pets. I did well but I had to focus most of my attention on this class and couldn't focus on my core major classes, which was really annoying. She one time put a 10 hour homework assignment due on the same day as an exam, and the homework didn't help me "study" like she claimed it would do. She's just mean.

Shes just not a nice person. Shes a decent lecturer and teacher but infuriating to talk to. During a quiz, she didnt let a someone give another person a spare calculator. That person just simply forgot their calculator but she screwed them over. She also yells at students to not cheat and she says she monitors chegg regularly.

She does a good job at explaining the content and giving lots of examples. There is some homework but you get quite a bit of time to work on it. It's not the hardest class ever but if you don't go to class it may get difficult. If you understand the practice problems you'll do fine in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Ce-Ce is a pretty good professor. Class is fairly easy to understand if you attend her lectures. I also took this class with her online and it was horrible. Didn't have any issues doing it in person, but when the course is remote, she is more concerned with people cheating than she is the class itself. Do NOT use Chegg otherwise she will flip a lid
The way she replied to my email was so rude. Luckily the course was easy and I just decided not to ask a single question anymore.

I personally did not find the course material to be challenging. However, she gives a lot of work that takes a lot of time to complete. She explains the material very clearly and the exams are straightforward. She can come across as rude and abrupt sometimes.

She is a really great professor who understand the material and uses great examples to get her point across. The course was easy to follow and she did an awesome job with the class given the circumstances. She is a great professor and I highly recommend to anyone!

Gives plenty of time to do the homework and posts all of her lectures on brightspace. everything you need to know is in the lectures and with her quizzes and exams being open notes, if you prepare and also make a couple of cheat sheets the course will be easy to get through.
Really thoughtful and understanding professor! I've had very few teachers that seem to care about mental health and being understanding towards individual student's situations. Very kind person.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: This professor handled the 2020 pandemic and semester assignments poorly. This course was extremely fast paced and the class averages for two exams were below 70% (66% and 53%). Rarely gave extra credit and showed no sympathy for her students. This professor spent more time trying to find cheaters in the class instead of actually helping students.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: By far one of the WORST professors I have had at Purdue. She is a terrible communicator and her class is laid out terribly. It was an overall terrible experience. Avoid her like the plague.

Homework weighs really heavy and so she really goes hunting people down on whether they are using outside sources for help. The lecture videos or powerpoints are often way harder than the homework. Her emails come off crazy and rude sometimes but this class is mandatory so I guess students just have to bear with it.
Sent several emails when I had a grief absence and received no response or extra time on assignments. I would rather pull all my toenails off than have this professor again.

Ce-ce is a great instructor for anyone new to Statistics. She explains every concept thoroughly and cares for her students deeply. She does a lot of examples in class to ensure that students understand the course material well.
Really helpful professor. She kind of acts like your mom, but in a good way.? Attendance isn't required but she has random checks and that counts toward your 15 points participation. So go to class!

She was probably the most helpful professor I have had at Purdue.  Always making that extra effort to make sure the students who want/ask for help get the best possible answer they can.  Very clear and straight forward in lecture.  Overall great professor!
She's awesome. She is pretty clear about the instructions and when you dont get something she will explain it wel.
She teaches class pretty decent but she basically just read off from her notes and thats it. I had to study alone
Ce-Ce is friendly and seems to know the names of all the students in her lecture.
Fairly easy to understand. Could be a little better.  Class is easy so it doesn't really matter.
Class is a lot of work.  Insstructor really tries to make it understandable.  Some test questions are tricky.
Ce-Ce is very nice and clearly explains the material.  You have to work hard in this class, but she does a great job.  Great smile, too!
Class is difficult.  They really make you work hard--always seems to be an assignment due.  Ce-Ce really tries to make the material understandable and is available for questions outside of class.

Ce-Ce Furtner is unclear and not very unapproachable. She acts like she knows everything about statistics and expects you to as well. You'll learn more in the tutoring center or from buying guide books than you will from her.
Great professor, very passionate and caring!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Harwood is a great professor; she truly cares about her students passing the class. She is accessible outside of office hours if needed. You should be ready to read the assigned textbook sections before class and complete assignments on time. She has a scattered brain in lectures, but watch videos online to fill in blanks.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Harwood for both CHEM111 and CHEM112. She is overall a super sweet pressor that cares a lot about her students and wants them all to succeed. If you have a question or attend her office hours she is always happy to help. However, her lectures and Brightspace were always unorganized. She oftentimes does not get through all of the content.

Very nice person, not a great professor. Very unorganized and would not even get through required content. Things would show up on the exam that she had not even shown how to do in class. One time something we learned DAY OF in lab showed up on the exam that night. I always had to teach myself topics because lecture never helped.
Harwood is a great professor who listens to her students and helps in any way she can. The course was averagely hard and if you put in the work, you get a good grade.

I don't really enjoy Chemistry but Dr. Harwood made it tolerable! She's a little all over the place in lecture sometimes but they're great nonetheless. There's extra-credit opportunities as well as drops for lowest scores. 7:30am labs are truly evil though, AVOID THEM!!!!! Also, the Brightspace page is a mess so get ready for that.
Great overall professor for gen chem, understands we are humans.

Dr. Harwood is very sweet and she truly does want every student to succeed. However, I found her class to be difficult because she is disorganized and her lectures are all over the place. She gives lots of examples but doesn't tie topics together which is crucial for this class. She gives lots of homework and it can be hard to keep up with it all.

Prof. Harwood cares a lot about the course and the students and makes sure to answer questions and help students. Makes a big class feel small! Take advantage of resources on campus including professor and TA office hours, the Chem Resource Room in Wetherill, SI session, and free tutoring on campus. Good Luck!

Dr. Hardwood is amazing. She is so accessible outside of class and she wants you to succeed. She knows the topics that are hard and makes an effort to help students with those. I found lecture to be helpful even though it wasn't mandatory. If you make a little effort you will be rewarded in her class.

Dr. Harwood is a great professor in my opinion. Coming into this class, I have a background of chemistry classes, so I found this class easy. My peers who did not have chemistry experience still found it easy to understand what she is teaching. Dr. Harwood also posted accurate expectations for exams. However, there is a cumulative final :(

Dr. Harwood is deeply caring in a way that is not seen often with professors who have more than 300 students in each lecture. She is funny, kind, but most importantly fair. She reflects on how her teaching has set a student up for success or failure, and will give you opportunities to gain points if she feels that the grading was unfair.

so this professor is fine. but a lot of the times she trips over her own words and recently her lectures have been useless and did not provde any examples. if there were examples they would be really simple and did not correlate to the hw much. 111 was easy if you took chem in high school, it is pretty much a review. but this class ight 6/10 ya dig

I am so bad at science so I was nervous for this class but Dr. Harwood really helped me understand the material. There is a lot of busy work and homework for this class, which kind of sucks, but it really does help you on the exams. The class is very well organized.

Lecture is not mandatory but you get extra credit if you go, there are exams in the class but if you study for them you will do okay. She is really helpful and does her best to make sure everyone does well in the class.

Dr. Harwood really cares about her students' success. She constantly has TAs walking around the lecture hall making sure that the students understand coursework and homework questions. She is a great professor, and I would recommend this class.
Great professor who genuinely wants to help her students and teaches good lectures
Professor Harwood explains things very well and helped me to understand every topic we covered.

Dr. Harwood is so incredible. She is down to earth and genuinely wants to help her students. She always made herself available to students. She had student hours instead of office hours because she would work almost one-on-one with students on homework or other projects. She is also super funny. Exams only make up 40% of your grade.
She explains the material very well in class and answers all questions in an easy to understand way. Very enthusiastic about teaching. Material was easy if you go to lectures and may attention.
Very nice Professor

Harwood was always super sweet and if you went to her with questions she would make sure you fully understood before you left. She genuinely cares about you and will do her best to make sure you do well.
There are weekly homework assignments, biweekly quizzes, and two finals, one midterm and one cumulative final. Dr. Hardwood is always willing to help if you just ask and is very personable.

This professor did not know how to explain material. She stumbled over her words and concepts nearly every lecture. I was teaching the concepts to those around me more than she was helping. She cannot do basic math equations and often mixes up the concepts more than helps.

This semester, 111 didn't have any exams just weekly quizzes. Harwood was very nice and made learning chem not unbearable. She also replied to emails quickly. Lectures weren't horrible to attend and you have the option of attending any that they offer.
CHM112 was harder than 111 in my opinion. But as usual, Harwood is an amazing professor. She is very reasonable, and there were TONS of extra credit opportunities in 112 that helped my grade a lot.

Dr. Harwood is AMAZING!!!! If you're someone that doesn't have a background in chem this is the class/professor perfect for you. She is easily accessible, hilarious, goes into just the right amount of depth, and great at explaining complex topics.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: So disorganized. Avoid this professor- very difficult to talk to and uncaring

This professor doesn't belong in academia. Instead of teaching, he has AI do it all for you. No one has learned anything remotely finance related in his course. He has no clear rubric, and you could follow the exact same process for two different assignments and get a C on one and an A on another.

I wish I had a different 310 professor because I learned almost no finance. STRONG FOCUS ON AI. There were no tests, only videos using AI to solve problems and write Python scripts we had to explain. There was no rubric, and the projects made me want to pull my hair out after talking to AI for 6 hours straight.

Professor Cirik is a good professor, his class just needs restructuring. It is on zoom and he reads straight from the PowerPoint until the last minute. However, he's nice and responds to emails quickly. If this class was in person, it would be great. You do only have test and project grades, so there is no homework grade cushion.

I had him at LSU and his lectures were pretty boring. He gave extra credit if you came to class, but attendance was not mandatory (though he did give credit for participation). The tests were mostly test bank, and the group project is on an article chosen by him and it was fairly easy. Not a hard class, but also not very fun.
I like the examples Kubilay gives about the different companies and their strategies. Picturing companies and the different types of strategies and structures makes the material more interesting.
Prof Cirik is very intelligent and worldly, makes every class super engaging. Easily one of the best professors I had at Krannert.
Lectures were clear and informative. I liked the occasional videos shown in the class. I really learned a lot in this course, it's one of my favorite classes I have taken at Purdue.
Professor Cirik is very smart and friendly. He is very successful in relating the course material to the real world.
Good professor, always ready to help ..
Great professor who is always available for help, always relates course materials to the real business world..
Professor Kubilay is very knowledgeable and genuinely wants to ensure we learn the concepts well. He is always available for help.
Too stubborn.....I don't know why. I totally agree with one evaluation below mine.

Kubilay  Cirik is a knowledgeable professor. However,  the professor has incredibly petty rules.  Grading depends solidly on 2 exams and a group project. Tests are hard and if you fail one, you better to drop the class. Also, the professor presents the material in a boring way.

This is my 5th course with Professor Cisney, and I have enjoyed all of them enormously. Throughout my time on campus, I have yet to take a class with a more caring, genuine, and down-to-earth professor than him. He is noticeably passionate about the subjects he teaches, and will help you if you reach out to him seeking guidance on an assignment.

His Philosophy in Film FYS was one of my favorite classes at Gettysburg. His lectures are the best! He splits class time between lecturing on important background information and cultivating engaging discussions with his students. He also truly cares for his class.  He is clear in what he expects on papers, and I found him to be a fair grader.

Cares a lot about his classes, very helpful for the most part if you go to his office hours. Hw is just keeping up on reading and the lectures in class are very important because he will go over things

Make sure you go to lecture, even though he posts outlines online. He's an entertaining lecturer and really does his best to help everyone understand  the material. His exams are really easy if you just look over the study guide and ask questions about it before the exam. This was truly a fun class.

one of the best profs i had because he was so easy and friendly. his tests are easy and as long as you show up to class and pay attention he'll really help you understand what you need to know. likes to get to know his students and is really easy to talk to for help. make sure to put a little effort in and you'll really enjoy the class.
No Comments
He tries, but the voice... oh my God the voice.
Unfortunately you have to take the course...

Lectures largely unorganized with many tangents. Online lectures (due to COVID) consisted of pre-made slides with a handful of equations, talking, and pointing. No solutions given to exams or homeworks (and some homeworks continued from previous ones). Assignment instructions usually vague. Overall, Professor puts minimum effort into the class.

Homework is optional with answers not solutions, very little examples in lecture, 1st textbook is unclear. Had him for 1st half of class and it was ridiculously difficult. Had a different professor for 2nd half and that went much smoother.

He is very frustrating to listen to. Examples he gives in class are nowhere near as hard as the ones on the homeworks and exams. Spends the first 15 minutes of every class talking about random things that are unrelated to what youre learning. Projects are long (35-50 pages), and he doesnt address important parts of the project until due date.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Long homework which can be tedious and meaningless! Attend classes to get lecture notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: As others have stated, he frequently tells you to refer to the course text for info. While the text is actually quite useful at times, the topics he'll refer are sometimes not even covered in the text! His lectures are almost worthless, but I attended them all because that's just how I am and he'll usually tell you what questions are on the exam.

"Pretty straight forward" "just read it in the text" were phrases he would use far too often to get out of actually working through the problem. Especially for a 300 level Mechanical Engineering course.

Not only is professor Cipra terrible and explaining the material he needs to, he refuses to review material that is crucial for learning.  He will call everything (even brand new material) 'trivial' and will refuse to do examples.  Exams in this class are not about how well you can work through the material, but if you can see the subtle trick.

This guy knows his material but is incredibly withholding, intentionally only stating key information once or twice at a maximum. He has office hours during prime class time, and it is incredibly difficult to schedule meetings outside of that time.
Tough grader for no reason. Exams and labs aren't returned until the end of the semester. Exams don't test your knowledge of the subject only tests your ability to remember phrases from the book.

gives a ton of work and expects more from students than what they can give. No clear grading criteria. can give very dry boring lectures that are hard to follow. Close to useless in office hours because he explains it the same way again and again and gets frustrated when you don't understand.

Prof Cipra tries to be funny in the class with some outdated jokes. He expects something which he never conveys clearly. Very strict marking and the papers are very low on standard of engineering. He expects you to read some weird readings and you end up losing marks on the silliest of questions. Manages to screw up a v imp design course. VVPOOR.

Expected much more from this class. Ended up with exams which put an emphasis on study by heart and memorization book content and million bullet points. I found it very hard to memorize so many useless words   from the textbook. He made fun of something from my part of the world during my 1st semester in the U.S. Made me feel so unwelcome.

Exams require memorization which I feel is not an effective way to test students. I think his goal is trying to make sure you read the text. There are other ways that are less time consuming to do that. Otherwise I enjoyed the content and his methods of teaching.  Thought he was very good. Labs can be time consuming but are effective and relevant.

A difficult professor. Minutia focus. Complete disconnect to industry. Examinations are highly detailed. The project is  time consuming without benefit of academic or industrial skill development. Cipra is unhelpful. One positive, not hard to get A, only requires significant time.
He is the most helpful prof ever seen. Though I think he should increase the standard of the grad course he teaches.
Clear, easy-going, uses real world examples & creates simulated real-world projects.  One of the best professors for preparing students for careers outside of academia.
Very practical.  Very interesting.  Clarity, well spoken.  Uses life examples.

Because this class is taught on campus and via television broadacst (taped), it is challenging to meet the demands of all students.  The prof. does an excellent job presetning the material in such a way that those both on and off campus can understand it
good

The professor is HORRENDOUS and ARROGANT. His tests come from no where. Read the book, study the notes, do LOTS of homework/projects and still NOT get a good grade. No Feedback either. Tests do not reflect the material learned in class.

I'm currently finishing my Masters through Purdue and haven't learned a thing through Purdue that I hadn't already learned from a Michigan University I will never recommend anybody I ever meet to go to Purdue.  Cipra was the worst instructor of all.

Is a total idiot and has not a clue what we struggle through. If all students fail, that means the teacher failed them. Did not learn a thing, other than how self-centered a person can be. Waste of time as to the many long long hours of unnecessary work.
Cipra needs to learn how to teach, too bad he does not keep up with technology. He is also very arrogant!!

Worst professor on the face of the earth. I would like to elaborate more, but I'll end up saying something I shouldn't be saying. Why is this person allowed to teach. A big waste of my time. My advise is to take this course thru CMU.

This was the worst class I have ever taken. I am still waiting for assignments to be returned and the class has been over for 2 months. My son will never attend Purdue unless he's looking to pluck chickens.
It was the worst coarse I have ever taken. I would take another class with him as the professor.
Worst professor I have ever had.  Appeared as if he wanted his students to fail.

This course is offered to students that are currently working in the vehicle engineering field. That being said, this prof seems to carry some sort of grudge against the people that are actually working in the field that he could not. Rating cont. below..
N/A

C.doesnt recognize that students in this course work 10 hours a day,most are also parents. He should come down from his ivory tower and get a view of the real world, before he attempts to operate in it.My 10 yr old wants to know why he doesnt get fired!
Professor believes students should struggle in order to learn. Enough said.

It seems obvious that he has no experience in the field in which he teaches.  The material he covers is basic, but he somehow makes it hard.  He overloads you with work and will test you on trivial information.
The Worst Professor i ever had,in the. He load you with so many thing to do, Just to keep you from finding out that he really don't know his job. My last class from Purdue.
Mr Cipra lacks ethic. He memorizes his class,when he is questioned about a subject, his respond is not clear. Besides, he pushes students to do things his way, but not the practical/correct way.

Exams require memorization of facts from the text that are otherwise useless.  Labs are time intensive, but not as significant a portion of overall grading as would be expected for the time required to complete the projects.  Lectures are slow paced.
Very poor teaching skills, He knows subject matter very well, but waste lecture time on unimportant material. Very tough EXAMS.
He is the most unhelpful teacher I've ever had. He gives Purdue a bad name.
One of the worst professors I've ever had. I would not take any classes he's teaching.
No Comments
criptic in his explanations and tries to trick you on tests

Nothing could pull me into another class led by Professor Munt. I would change majors before sitting through another one of these classes. The whole class felt performative… it felt like he wanted us to be his adoring fans, and it never sat right with me. I got through it, but at the cost of some of my mental health. Received almost no feedback.

There was so much reading due each week and it often didn't relate that much to the class. Also there were a lot of long papers throughout the semester and I never received any real feedback on them. He seems really nice and caring but the way he structured the class made me dread going to it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--So many papers

reviews.comment: He was kind and caring but he assigned a lot of useless reading and unnecessarily long papers just to give zero useful feedback on them. The class content got boring and repetitive, and it became difficult to bring myself to go to this class towards the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--So many papers

reviews.comment: He is super caring and friendly! Took his class for my minor and I loved it. He clearly cares about his students and is very understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: The class wasn't hard, and the content was okay. There definitely wasn't enough substance to make me love it. Professor Munt was kind, but gives off a level of arrogance/self-importance that definitely dragged down his score for me. Fair grader, but definitely could have behaved less like royalty. Teach a class vs. basking the spotlight/attention.

Christopher is a really nice and easy to talk to professor. He seems genuinely interested in his students' voices, thoughts, and perspectives on issues revolving around the LGBTQ community. My only issue is that he takes forever to grade assignments so it's tough to predict your final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: very fair, write a couple papers and do some weekly assignments for a fair grade

Christopher is an amazing person. He is such an advocate for the LGBTQ+ community, and he is extremely understanding of conflicts in other classes. I would love to take another class from him, as class was very interesting and he is very open to feedback. I recommend WGSS 282 to everyone.

Prof. Chakraborty is an excellent instructor who genuinely cares about student learning. He frequently connects concepts to real-world engineering problems. He is also very approachable and always willing to help. Exams are tough.
Nice guy, but the course is a huge drag and lectures are way too long and boring. straightforward A/A- though, just a ton of busy work.
Suman is a great lecturer and very knowledgeable, but it often feels li
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor was borderline sadistic at times. Would make extremely difficult exams and smile as he walked through the aisle seeing students struggle. Assignments would be graded weeks after being turned in. Purdue prop specialization is so disorganized.
Extremely poor communication with students in the class for assignment requirements. Not aware of university policies.

He's a terrific lecturer and is very nice and approachable outside of class. However, the way he ran this course was awful. Homework and exam grades were often not given for months after the deadline, and the midterms for this class were genuinely impossible. He also assigned a literature review due 2 days before the final. I hope he improves.

Had Suman for an online course. He was terrible. Consistently late with posting assignments, content and grades.  Never provided feedback to the class for our final projects and assignments. It felt like he was rushed at the end of the course to make assignments up then he dumped a ton of work on us without much notice. Worst online course ever.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Solid professor. Lectures are a bit slow but also the course is quite light on content. Great at answering questions
Handwritten notes rather than reading off slides, and she is generally friendly.

Loved her as my professor. You could tell that she was engaged with the course content by the way she lectured and answered questions. I found it super helpful that she projected hand written notes as she lectured, rather than just teaching from premade slides. Her lecturing pace was perfect.

My number 1 thing with her: she writes out all of her notes. This is insanely helpful. Thermodynamics, kinetics, and equilibrium are all math heavy concepts, and her drawing everything out makes it so much more digestible. Very few profs seem to be putting in the effort to write out all of their notes. Her speaking abilities are strong.

Professor Li is so good. I loved her and I'm hoping she teaches other classes because she made me really excited to come to lecture. She's very personable and easy to watch. Highly recommend to anyone who struggles with coming to lecture because you'll want to come with her lecturing.

Dr. Li is an amazing lecturer overall, during the first half of the semester of CHM 116 I had a perfect 100 percent in the class as she covers almost everything you need to know for homework and exams. I would still supplement her lectures by reading the textbook, as she does not use too many examples and skims over easier topics.

Professor Li is a great professor. She writes everything down as she teaches instead of reading off of slides. This helps you understand exactly what is important. She also does examples by hand which is helpful too. Overall, great professor. If you are taking 116, try to get professor Li.

If you're in CHM 116, go to Dr. Li's lectures and office hours! She delivers simple, and straight to the point lectures without going off on tangents or overcomplicating information. First exam was really rough, but if you go to her office hours, she'll give you study tips/strategies for how to do better in the course. Overall,very nice and caring.

Great at teaching, seems to care about student's success, great handwriting and writes lecture notes. She explains topics really clearly and her examples are helpful when doing the homework. One of my favorite professors so far.
She is a pretty good lecturer. She lectures at a great pace to take notes. Will require a weekly PARTE class which is basically mandatory TA office hours with ~300 people. Not a fan.
Best handwriting in the game. Clear explanations on what is being lectured and does a good job of reading the chat during broadcasted lectures. Glad to have her for CHM116

Dr. Li is fantastic. Best lecturer for CHM116! If you simply go to lecture, right down everything she explains/writes in her lecture notes, you should be prepared for most of the things on the exam. It's hard to get an A, but if you pay attention in lecture you'll definitely have a chance. No extra cred and exams are about 60% of the grade!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Her lectures were excellent. She wrote everything out live (no powerpoints). There were lots of examples. She oversimplified things sometimes, which hurt me on the tests. Still, the best gen chem teacher I had.
Li was a great teacher! She explained things really well and gave mathematical examples as well as demonstrations. She teaches at a really good pace also, and she's super sweet and funny!
Great professor, Helpful in office hours! Wasn't the best student and had to work hard, but I did well considering how I struggled with CHEM 115

Dr. Li was a good lecturer. She explained all the topic in depth. In my opinion, I thought she dumbed chemistry down a little too much, considering how hard the exams were, but I would take a dumbed down version than a too technical one. However, she walked us through a lot of examples, which was helpful.
Professor Li explains things very clearly! She has no accent, writes legibly, and covers all the material from the homework/exams. I really enjoyed havin her, because she made a hard class seem easy.

I think these other ratings are super harsh on Dr. Chester. If you want a professor that just recites out of a textbook, that's your personal opinion. Dr. Chester is an amazing, knowledgeable professor that speaks straight from her own personal research and experience in the field. 10/10 professor
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The course was basic and not very engaging and I would give it an overall "Meh" rating. But, the worst part and the reason for the lower score is due to her insistence on injecting her personal/political beliefs. Please keep those thoughts to yourself.

Very eh class.

This class would be way better if it was structured and had a textbook. It felt very much like Dr. Chester came in and presented whatever she wanted that day.
I think I realized attendance was mandatory because she knew no one would come otherwise

Show up to class and do 1 homework per week, and you immediately get more than half the points in the class. Content is interesting and is presented in a way to promote critical thinking and discussions. Don't expect a cookie cutter list of things and facts to memorize since this is an upper level course. Overall, it was fun and easy to get an A.
One of my least favorite professors at Purdue. She seems knowledgeable but has no idea how to teach.
I've missed at leased half of the classes this semester and am not sure that isnt a bad thing.  I really don't learn much in class as she picks and chooses various items from the text to go over.

Julia Chester seems to not be concerned with teaching psychology rather expressing her views on certain groups of people. She constantly belittled the greek system, perhaps a reject? Frequently off topic, and egotistical.

Not gonna lie. This woman is my least favorite teacher up here at purdue. I understand that the class is supposed to be easy. But the exams werent the easiest things. We had a 100 question final...ridiculous...and lecture was soo boring that I was always finding myself falling asleep. Take it if you must..but get a different professor..its worth it

Really easy class, but beware of the final! It ended up being 55% of our grades my semester, and even though I had over 100% going into the final I barely came out with an A because I slacked off studying for it
Class is frustrating and very disorganized.  We took our second exam without getting the scores from the first exam back.  Talk about ridiculous.
Class was easy. I stopped going to class once I did well on the first exam. Read the book and do the extra credit, it will get you through the class.
I got over a 100% in this class, she put all the notes up online so you don't need to go to class... just make sure you do all the extra credit it adds to be something liek 15% of your grade
so easy if you know the study guide you are good.
She repeats the power point slides verbatim.  Nothing you can't read on your own.  Don't bother buying the book and don't bother going to class.  It's a very easy A.
boring
didn't like her...she was pretty strict, there were a lot of memorizations.her slide shows were basically outlines out of a textbook as well

don't bother going to class...shes nice, kinda funny, but she reads straight off the slides. the semester i had her she offered tons of online extra credit which could help you final grade by up to 8%. her tests are ok, you can get C's on them without studying.
one of worst classes ever taken, hate psychology because of her
Good Prof

This woman essentially read off of a powerpoint for her lectures with very little other input.  Going to class was rather pointless.  Her tests were very difficult with a range of topics that were too broad and some of them too complicated for a 100 level class.  This was the second worst class I have taken here at Purdue.
No Comments
I thought she was decent.  Not great, but still made class interesting
she treats the class like we're infants.
Went to class every day up until Exam 1, got a B, skipped class once a week or so until Exam 2, Skipped class A LOT up until exam 3, got an A...ended up with an A. Class is easy.
Worst professor that I have had at Purdue.
Young, energetic, likes what she teaches and teaches it well.  I thought the class was interesting and easy.

Dr. Chester should stick to her **** lab mice research, NOT teaching.  She treated the entire class like 4-year olds because a few were freshman, and went on to explain how to answer a multiple choice question.  The class was so dumbed down her lab mice might have aced it.
one of the worst professors I have ever had, if you're taking this class, take it with someone else!
Harder class that you can't stay awake in.  Definitely not an easy A.  You are better off reading the book and not going to class.

SCLA 101 was my least favorite class of my first semester of FYE. This is because of Professor Mason. She did not teach me a singular thing the entire semester. She throws assignments at you that are massive amounts of your grade and just expect you to do well on your own. Her class left me dreading each time I had to see her. Avoid at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Amazing professor! With Mason, SCLA 101 quickly became my fav class of the week. She is incredibly sweet, will remember your name since the first day of class and gives great feedback. Be aware, however, that she is a strict grader, so if you try to do your work last minute you will be done for.
She is an awesome professor, gives good feedback, and cares about you and your work. Would recommend taking her for SCLA101.

You can tell she truly cares about her students and teaching. Her class is really engaging and she gives us plenty of time for assigments. I never like English classes but she made this one really fun, would definitely recomend taking her for SCLA101 if you can.

For a mandatory class for some majors, it was honestly fun. Professor Mason makes you think about things from an entirely new perspective, which I was surprised by. Also, DO NOT PULL UR PHONE OUT IN CLASS. SHE WILL MARK YOU ABSENT. BELIEVE ME SHE CAN SEE WHEN UR PHONE IS OUT. YOU CAN NOT HIDE IT.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I thought SCLA 101 with Professor Mason would just be another FYE hoop for me to jump through, but instead turned out to be very fun, and a great break in my day from my typical engineering classes.  You get a lot of freedom in your writing, and lectures are very engaging and fun.  It actually might have been one of my favorite classes in FYE.

Professor Mason does a great job of giving her students creative freedom throughout the semester! Often times you forget you are working because you have a lot of room to have fun with the projects. BE AWARE that there is more to the syllabus assignment than you may think... overall amazing professor though!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is WONDERFUL & kind! Cares about students learning and there is tons of extra credit and she gives her students an assignment where THEY can change the syllabus and we all vote on it. She encourages us to engage outside the classroom- especially by going to Purdue Theatre events for xcredit. She gives good feedback on papers. Take her class!

Professor Mason creates an engaging environment so that students can feel comfortable participating in the classroom. She assigns fun papers/projects that don't limit our creative freedom. She also gives a bunch of extra credit opportunities to boost your grade. Only thing is that she can be a harsh grader on bigger assignments.

very harsh grader. wont accept anything less than the best. lots of reading outside of class. she does offer a lot of extra credit though. she also allows the students to change the syllabus(by writing a 1500-2000 word essay on why it should change). was fun writing in her class as a creative outlet. takes points off of you don't attend class.

I've never done below a C+ or a B- in an English course and being a freshman straight out of highschool this was more than I've ever done in a high school's worth of two semesters. Way too much work. I would not recommend. Switch if you can this course will hurt your GPA if you are not good at essays. She's sweet but strict.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: harsh grader, way too much work for a 101 course, extrmely not recommend

She is a great person, but the amount of work she assigns is insane for a regular SCLA 101 course. Also, she's the hardest grader I've ever met. Long story short, if you want an easy GPA booster without doing too much work, this professor is not for you, but if you want to be challenged and have a more rigorous week, I recommend it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Horrendous
She is AMAZING!

I liked Professor Mason, but this class is too much work for an SCLA 102 course. There are a lot of assignments, a lot of readings, and assignments. She is also a bit of a tough grader and I constantly had at least 3 assignments due for her. Crafting our own syllabus is nice, but it came with stipulations. I wouldn't take this class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Claire Mason works hard to create a very engaging/fun environment in the classroom and is overall a great person, despite doing poorly I recommend the class to anyone who likes group oriented work, since nearly the entire class is group based and has almost no individual work, if you don't like this you will probably find it as miserable as I did.

Dr. Mason is great! At the beginning of the semester, she allows us to change the syllabus which is great. She also gives great feedback on assignments which allows you to know how to improve. Class is unpredictable in the fact that you do something new almost every day. She is also super enthusiastic and wants every student to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Very unpredictable. Class was cool though. I reccommend taking with friends.

She really cares about each and every student. She makes class as enjoyable as possible, and I never minded going to class. Also, she does a wonderful job in supporting class participation and creates an atmosphere with little to no judgement from any of your peers. Can grade a bit strict, but you have plenty of opportunities to help your grade.

Dr. Mason was one of my first professor my first semester of college and she didn't disappoint. Make sure to attend class and participate which will make the class much more enjoyable than what it already is. Although she doesn't give a lot of work, make sure you perform quality assignments as she will not just hand out free A's. Fantastic teacher.
Dr Claire was amazing, she really cares about her students and takes time to make sure everyone is doing ok

Prof. Mason is fantastic, although attendance isn't mandatory you will want to go to class because it is so fun. Its a speech class but it doesn't feel scary at all. Almost all your speeches are in a group and prof. is very encouraging and makes the environment really safe to participate. HIGHLY ENCOURAGE YOU TO PICK HER AS YOUR PROFESSOR!

Professor Mason is an amazing teacher. She is always caring and thoughtful of her students. She actually listens to students and tries to work their needs into her lessons. I would recommend her over any other SCLA 102 professor.
Professor Mason clearly cares about her students and makes a point of listening to feedback. Her class was the highlight of my day.
This was a great class and Mrs. Mason did a fantastic job making the class fun.

Prof Mason is very energetic and passionate. She finds unique ways to teach us and accomplish learning objectives. The class is pretty easy in terms of workload, but you should still be ready to be challenged.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher who knew the class well and taught it through projects and speeches that improve your ability to succeed in the real world, as opposed to pointless arguments or reading.

Dr. Claire is by far the best professor I have ever had. As of now, she is a visiting professor, so if given the chance I highly recommend taking her class before she leaves. Her lectures are very eye-opening and the readings all collect into this giant understanding of communication and culture. A chaotic but very fun-loving professor.

Professor Mason is one of the best Professors I have ever had and probably ever will have. Not only does she care deeply for her students, but she also makes sure we are understanding the material. Attendance was mandatory in some of her classes, but in our class, you could present to the class why you missed, and they voted on if you got credit.
Prof. Chapple was a good lecturer, and was very passionate about the topic. Homeworks and exams depended heavily on lecture content. Even as a non-bchm major I found the class interesting and easy.
