reviews.comment: One of the most appalling professors I have had. For a technical writing course her course set up on BrightSpace was both laughable and very unironic of how poorly formatted it was, making it extremely difficult to navigate among the plethora of course content. She put below minimum effort into course and certainly did not lead by example.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class was absolutely awful. We had long online lectures where she talked constantly and repeated herself every 30 seconds, total waste of time. Grading criteria was never clear, group projects were terrible, and overall I learned nothing about technical writing. Don't bother taking this class with her.

Tracy likes to talk...a lot. We have 1.25 hour classes and she talks the entire time yet we are all still confused as to what is expected of us. She is very wordy in her explanations yet conveys nothing. I don't feel like I am in a health and human sciences writing class. She is teaching like she's teaching a multimedia/technical writing class. :(
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Absolutely awful. Requires mountains more work than any other professor teaching this class. I've learned nothing, despite spending way more time on this class than it deserves. Her project descriptions and syllabus are long, unclear, and (ironically) terrible examples of technical writing. Take this course with anyone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: At first, I had an open mind after viewing RateMyProfessor, but after starting and going through the class I agreed with the comments. She didn't provide clear guidelines, due dates, or grading criteria. If you are a tech or engineering student, request to have another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: While you may find that some of the lectures are a bit dull, attendance for this class is mandatory. Clark does talk a lot during lectures and goes on a lot of tangents but the material is helpful. No quizzes or tests, you will be graded on 3 projects and a combination of other stuff for the last percentage of your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: So Tracy seems like a person who took a crash course on ENGL 421 and now teaches it in just the way she knows how. She is not flexible at all when it comes to her rubric and almost comes off as arrogant with the way she likes a project to be done. However, she is very quick with her feedback and her regrades are very generous points wise.

Tracy is a knowledgeable professor but is VERY dry -- Bored-to-tears dry. Attendance is mandatory so you have to sit & deal. Weekly blog HW. 3 major projects, 2 are group. Has high expectations but provides feedback to help you achieve. Offers re-grade submissions. Extremely useless lectures. If u can, get another professor. If not, muddle through.
What a sweet lady. let's you correct your homework to turn in again. But yes, takes a bit of work through the semester.

Very very vague deadlines, difficult to find requirements, poor communication, and it seems as if grading is entirely arbitrary. I submitted a project for revision, after changing nothing, and went from a 68%->92%, with the professor citing "Major improvement"

Her rubrics are very vague and typically not given out until you've already started a project. Then, she fails to grade according to her rubrics. If you don't read her mind and do it exactly how she would have, you get a bad grade. The feedback she will give you is extremely wordy and not at all concise. And, group work online is not practical.

For an online course she expects way too much out of her students.  Students that take online courses do so because they're schedules don't allow for the dedication of lecture time and she takes the extra accountability WAY too far.  Expecting 7 writing assignments per week is counter-intuitive to learning in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Literally, take this with any other prof. She is absolutely horrid on too many levels to describe here.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Most boring class you could take. Easy class just take it with any other teacher. Lectures are pointless and monotone. She is obsessed with blogging.

Lecture time taken up with Tracey talking, hardly ever working on actual assignments, attendance taken every class, and all writing done by her is needlessly lengthy without getting to the point.  Expect unnecessary details spread over a tedious lecture, and existing writing skills to be tested as no new ones are gained.

I found her to be one of the easiest graders at Purdue. Projects were submitted, then reviewed by her. You have a week to revise (she tells you exactly what she wants), and then turn it in again and you keep your highest grade. Flexible on deadlines. Class is boring but it would be better if people actually cared enough to interact. She's not bad.
This class was pointless. Though her grading was relatively easy, I didn't learn anything from the class and felt time in class was wasted.
OMG...no other way to say it
Quite possibly the worst teacher I've ever had. She grades incredibly hard, gives out 3X more assignments than any other teacher in 420. She requires a 15 page single spaced paper due the last week.

She gives about 5 times as much work as anyone else teaching this class... and I didn't learn anything from it.  It has been my biggest waste of time ever!  If you have to take Engl 420 switch to a different section!
What a pointless class.
To be honest, if you do the homeworks and participate in the classes, it is an easy A (for SCLA110).
he isn't that difficult unless you are just a lazy person he does kind of seem like a weirdo but hey his class is easy af
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Hilarious is not a compliment. The ONLY reason the class was difficult is his teaching.

Everything he does is quite unclear - He doesn't put rubrics on how he grades specific assignments and he's weird. And for some reason he thinks he's funny. I asked several times about where can I learn more about his grading policies and he didn't clear up any confusion. His classes are hella boring. Wouldn't recommend taking this weirdo's class.

I don't understand why Professor Ty is getting all this hate. His class always was a great place to be at and the workload is really not that bad. I spent very little time working on the assignments given to me and passed with an easy A.
He is overall a great professor with fun classes and funny.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He's nice person but his hw instructions are awful. It's very unclear and he doesn't have his brightspace well displayed
Lots of homework but gives plenty of time to do it. Not a bad class
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Even though the workload is important, Professor Climer genuinely looks like he loves his class. I only had one in-person class and really enjoyed it. I just wish some extra credits were available.

I would probably take Ty's class again. My biggest issue with his instruction was vague feedback that often went against what he would teach in class. He encouraged us not to heavily quote sources but would deduct points on assignments for doing just that. Even though I got an A, I disagreed with some of his reasoning for my grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: gives 2 much work
Gives a lot of homework but grades very lieniently so if you show up to class and turn everything in on time you will do well.
This professor is among the worst. Its an easy A class but he gives too much work and his lectures are extremely boring. Dont take his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Good lecture
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Interesting lecture, but: Too much homework Too much presentation GPA Killer Unorganized
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great professor that obviously knew what he was talking about. Lectures were very important despite not being mandatory. The time spent on homework every week was more than all of my other classes combined but definitely worth it. Midterm is tough and definitely do not put off the final project!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Cory is a professor that clearly cares about his students. The homework assignments are lengthy, usually taking 3+ hours per assignment, but he works through many of the assignments in lecture. Don't put off any projects, especially the final project which easily takes 50+ hours to complete.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I never thought I'd ever find a class with such a workload for 2 credits. Clark is great outside of class. very understanding when it comes to health and personal matters outside of the classroom. But in class, its like a flip switches. If you don't understand it the first time, good luck... and be ready to spend a lot of hours on AutoCAD.

Clark Cory is one of the best professors I had at Purdue. As a civil eng. student, I feel like I have used his material the most of any other class in my internships. He is caring and understanding, down to earth, and teaches fundamentals that you will forever use. The class can be time consuming with assignments, but they truly make a difference.

Has real experience and is a pretty decent lecturer. Not difficult, just make sure you work on the final project well ahead of the deadline. Sometimes instructions are unclear or simply wrong so talk to your TA if you have a question. Midterm is pretty brutal so if you aren't decent at CAD by then that sucks. HW can feel like busy work

This is for CM360. Clark is extremely disrespectful, and will send very unprofessional and unclear emails. One of his emails has read “nope try again” in response to a very lengthy emails asking questions. This is especially unforgiving due to the fact that this class is only in person one day of the week. He also does not use bright space. 0/10

Prof. Cory was so much fun. He posted video demonstrations on how to do the CAD/Revit assignments. Easy-going. Midterm is really hard, simply because you don't have enough time. Labs never last full time. Class only meets at 5:30pm.

Clark gives you everything you need to succeed in this course (recorded lectures, lots of office hours, TAs), all you need to do is put in your end of the work. Don't start final project last minute and you'll be fine. Clark cares for his students and even promotes opportunities for students outside of class like internships and career fairs etc.

Professor Cory was a great lecturer, and his CGT 164 class is easily passable as long as you attend or watch the lectures. He also has a great deal of experience in the construction industry, so don't be afraid to come to him with any questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is awful. 0 help and always rude to students when you don't understand something. Ta's run his class and are the only way to be somewhat successful in his class.

Clark is great. He is kind and compassionate. He really cares about your education, and he wants you to succeed. The course is mainly one big group project the entire semester, so choose your group wisely. Coordination and communication are key.

Clark is a great professor who is super approachable and helpful outside of class. The course itself feels more like a 3 credit class with the amount of work given. Being a complete beginner in the software used in the class, there was a bit of a learning curve, but once again Clark's help outside of class was greatly appreciated.

Would highly recommend taking this class over the summer. Feels very high school esque with the sheer amount of busy work assigned every week. The class is only 2 credit hours, but will most likely be the class you spend the most time working on assignments for. Professor Cory is super approachable and will help you if you need it, though.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Easy to talk to, and open to meet outside office hours. Records all his classes so you do not need to attend. The videos are very helpful.

Clark is kind and really cares about how you do in class. He pushes you to learn the material and do your best, but never be afraid to ask questions if you are confused as he is readily available to answer any questions you might have. The course can be a lot if you don't have any CAD/Revit experience, but go to him if you are having any issues.

While this class is a lot of content for only 2 credits, Clark is amazing both in and out of class. He is available every day in his office - he will help a lot with sketching assignments, AutoCAD, and Revit if you go to office hours. Overall super nice professor and guy.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Cory, more so than any other instructor I've had at Purdue, genuinely seems to care that his students are prepared to hit the ground running when they start their careers. His lectures are dense but informative, and you will have no problem passing the class - even if you have no prior cad experience - if you show up and put the time in.

Great guy. Has a lot of experience in the construction industry and it shows. If you pay attention during lecture, you will know how to do the projects. He also posts recordings of the lectures online for your reference. Weekly quizzes are super easy. Usually responds to emails within 2 hours regardless of time of day.
He was rude and did not really help at times. His lectures were very useful, but the sample videos at times are very confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is a wonderful professor who is very helpful. If you have any questions you can always go to his office hours and he is happy to help. He also has many connections and will help point you in the right direction. Very nice and the class is not too bad as long as you stay on top of things.
Great Professor

Dr. Cory Clark is an excellent professor who wants the best for his students and it shows from feedback whenever you ask, texting him a question about the project at 2am, or stopping by his office to grab snacks. He has industry experience and many contacts outside of Purdue to help you get in touch with companies. Excellent teacher!

Easy class. Assignments are clear and mostly just replicate what you see. He gives quick instruction on how to do it in class but you only need to go to one of the two lectures for quizzes. He's extremely personable and easy to talk to outside of class for help. Also, he doesn't give out "minus" grades, so a 90% is an A.
Cory was a great professor and very willing to help via email or office hours. His class was overall fairly easy and enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Clark knows what he is doing with AutoCAD and Revit, so take detailed notes in lecture. At times he goes fast but if you don't understand/follow ask him after class, or he is extremely helpful in his office hours.

This class is difficult if you've never used the AutoCAD or Revit softwares.  Take good notes at demo.  Rely more on your TAs than Clark, if Clark fills in for your lab section, don't expect to get what you get out of TAs. He is rude and doesn't not speak elegantly and is condescending if you don't know what you're doing. Get help from TAs instead!

Fantastic professor - extremely helpful if you go to the office hours.  In this class you know that you are learning something.  Sense of humor, and writes great letters of recommendation upon graduation, if you ask.  Adds great value to Purdue's Tech group
This class can be difficult, particularly if you've never taken a CGT class before.  But he is extremely helpful and will spend all his extra time helping you if that's what you need.
vvv
Extremely helpful and clear.  As previously stated, he shows you how to do the homework in lecture and is always willing to lend a helping hand if you need it.
Very disorganized.
great guy, my favorite at Purdue!
Awesome guy, pretty much shows you how to do homework, very nice and helpful if you go to office hours.
He is a good professor that is available for you and explains everything very well and with detail.
great all around
Great Professor, though he does expect you to immdiately know as much as he knows about a certain thing.
Great class if you're willing to put in the outside effort.  His lectures are clear and helpful and he's always willing to help despite his overloaded schedule.

The course moves very quickly but he's more than happy to help out of class and after class as much as you need, as well as being around during the lab if you need help and he's not in class.  Good lecturer and has a sense of humor that makes sitting through class enjoyable.
Very knowledgeable and fun guy.  Gives open class quizzes and regularly cancels lecture.  Very easy and pretty fun too.
very good teacher and easy class, if u go

Prof. Conner is amazing. I very rarely rate professors, but I felt compelled to rate him. He LOVES Latin, which makes learning much more fun. Additionally, he's a very nice guy. Super understanding and easy to talk to. I recommend going to his extracurricular meetings (various classics related gatherings). They're a lot of fun.

Dr. Conner is by far my favorite professor thus far. He is extremely knowledgeable and intelligent and makes learning Latin an incredible experience. He is funny yet determined when it comes to his lectures. I cannot recommend his class enough.

Took him for Latin 101 and 102, he was an amazing teacher who cares about the success of all his students. There is a crazy amount of homework, but in return the grading is quite easy. I would recommend his classes to anyone.
Great professor, extremely knowledgeable and caring.

I would 100% take his class!! During class he goes over the important parts of the homework so you don't actually need to read! He explained things in a good way for students and is very passionate about what he does. Overall such a sweet guy!

Prof. Conner is the only English or communications teacher whose class I have enjoyed taking. The assigned readings are easy, and he sets you up greatly for your papers. His feedback is incredibly helpful and makes the lectures fun. Frequent extra credit opportunity.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great teacher, very passionate. The assigned reading is not too overwhelming. Attendance and participation is mandatory, but he allows for 3 absences per semester and there are weekly extra credit opportunities. Gives great feedback on papers and is not a hard grader. I'm happy that I was able to get another class with him in my schedule.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof Conner marks hard, but gives constructive feedback. He has required reading for each class, which can vary, and during midterms can feel very overwhelming. He has mandatory attendance (3 excused absences) but being there is not enough. You must ask questions or make comments based off the text to get points that affect your final grade.

Professor Conner is extremely down to Earth and caring. He is punctual and very lenient when it comes to grading and is willing to work with you if you are falling behind. Overall if you want to take Latin, his course is extremely well-paced and accommodating.

I took this class for SCLA 101 and it was a good class. Attendance is mandatory, however, there are 3 attendance drops which is extremely nice. The lectures can be a bit boring at times, but there were some interesting topics

I had Dr. Conner a few years ago but I am coming back to comment on how much of a difference he made in my college career. I am now a language teacher and he showed me what a good language teacher is supposed to be. He is understanding, accommodating, and his class is engaging. It is clear that he loves Latin and teaches it with passion.
Really good professor who cares for his students. He makes the class fun.
good professor

A really easy grader that makes sure that everyone is engaged within class and has the opportunity to ask questions. Makes discussions very engaging and gets to know the students. My only complaint would be the excessive amount of reading, but the assignments are reasonable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Normally, I am wary of English classes, but I really enjoyed this course. You are graded on 3 papers, 1 oral, weekly participation, and blog posts. The blog posts are easy and can usually be answered by the previous class. He is a very easy grader, and as long as you complete everything, it is an easy A.

I took this class because one of my friends took it last semester and said he is a great teacher. However, I did not think so. I emailed him several times to ask him questions. He did not reply to me what so ever. I went to his office hours, he is there the whole time. I waited for about 20 minutes and left. Participation is important in this class

Super nice teacher. I came into the class thinking i'd hate it and that it was a dumb gen ed but it was actually fun and helped me get more perspective on life. He's also super chill and funny and is very thorough with instructions. Makes sure no one is left behind or confused!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Daniel Conner is INCREDIBLE! I've taken several courses with him now, and he's been nothing short of a delight. He's funny, passionate about what he teaches, his lectures are easy to follow, he genuinely cares about his students, accommodates those who ask, is easily approachable, and loves questions. I've learned so much from him! Highly recommend

Professor Conner is my favorite professor at Purdue! He knows so much about Classics and is such a great lecturer. He really cares about how well we do in his classes, and actually makes me look forward to seeing the comments he made on my essays. I really hope I get to take another class with him.
Professor Conner is a great professor. He is really passionate about the material and gives a lot of great feedback on essays. He is very personable and friendly.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Enjoyed lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Daniel is hilarious and truly makes his class enjoyable. He clearly loves what he teaches and that enthusiasm is contagious. His lectures are easy to follow and he often makes modern references or encourages us to see how what we're learning in class can be tied to the real world. 10/10 would take another class he taught.

Conner has been my favorite prof so far. He's really nice and funny, and turns boring PPTs into really great lectures. I like how much he cares about what he's teaching, he's so passionate about it that even if someone hated classics/greek mythology, they would still find his lectures interesting.I really hope I get to take another class he teaches
I love his lecutures on Greek mythology! He is so funny and makes pop culture references and helps us understand the material well!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: One of my best professors, knowledgable on the topic and always willing to help, funny guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I think he took a great approach in explaining how operating systems worked throughout the semester and the class workload was really light.
Dr.Comer is obviously very smart and he is well respected inside the CS community. The class was fun.

Dr. Comer is obviously smart and well respected, and if you enjoy operating systems you will like his class. Otherwise, GTAs are not super helpful at all, and seem to just do whatever they want, and classes are a series of slides that have all the content for the course, but lectures are nothing but these slides.

Boring lectures. Easy to do homeworks and lab assignments with each taking around 3-4 hours a week. Be ready to go in blind into the midterm or finals because students have no access to practice or any past papers other than the hws which hardly resemble the content on the exams. Lectures are just a repetition of the slides and the textbook

I quite enjoyed Comer, and it was one of the easiest CS classes I've taken. His lectures synced up well with his self-written textbook, making it easy to self-learn his content without always attending lectures. My complaints are with his small, clueless TA team, the lack of a course calendar, and his tangents during lectures.

Please please please read the most recent reviews instead of the average rating. Like the other guy said, avoid at all cost. Grading is like a blackbox, no chance to regrade. Mood is unpredictable in class, sometimes derogatory to students. Never available for feedback or discussion outside of class. Little overlap between lecture content and exam.

Often goes on tangents during lecture, the final project (worth 60%) was vaguely mentioned in one class without providing any documents or grading criteria. It took until almost finals week for him to make a document about the project. The grading and rest of the non-lecture management of class is entirely handled by TAs.
No grading criteria given. No feedback. No regrade. Always belittling students in class and making inappropriate jokes. Avoid at all cost.

Would not recommend taking any classes w/ him. Unclear grading criteria that changes on a whim if some other group does something above & beyond. No feedback given for a majority of the course (60% final project and 10% oral final exam.) It feels like a non-transparent academic environment as no option to review assignments or ask for re-grades.

The professor blamed students for poor performance and became toxic toward the end. Project guidelines were vague, shared only after students' requests, and not used in grading. For a project worth 60% of the grade, you'd expect clear guidelines and some feedback after grading—neither was given. Avoid this class for your own good.

TLDR: toxic personality, harsh grader, don't take it as a PhD core course, average is a B.
The professor does not provide project outlines or grading rubrics, making expectations unclear. Grading for the group project is highly subjective, forcing students to guess what will be rewarded and to “outdo” other groups just to secure a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Just became very disgruntled and toxic. Became difficult being in his class toward the end.
boring lectures

Professor Comer is a treasure of the CS department. His lectures and slides are super well written and easy to follow. He always provides students with invaluable insight from his experience. He is constantly updating the material so it is as relevant as possible to students and is very easy to talk to outside class.

Professor Comer is easily the best CS professor at Purdue. His experience and wisdom inspire students to look for old solutions to emerging problems. I would highly recommend CS351 - Cloud Computing to anyone, and he is perfectly suited to teach students about novel concepts at the intersection of business and technology.

Comer is clearly a very intelligent and capable professor. However, he fails to communicate information, is untimely with turnaround, and appears to either have no control over his TAs or directs them to be unhelpful to students. Class was OK but be prepared for mandatory optional labs, TAs refusing to help you, and an overall terrible experience.
Simply the best!

(Review for CS490- Cloud Computing). Comer created this class and wrote the textbook for it. His lectures are fantastic. He has a rich history in CS and played a big role in the internet project. I have taken multiple classes with him and recommend that everyone does if they get the chance!

I took CS 590 Cloud computer in Spring 22 under prof. Comer. He literally wrote the book on the topic and condensed a vast topic into a semester of really interesting and insightful lectures. His homework really made you think hard both from an engineer as well as a managers perspective. Would be glad to take any of his courses again.

Professor Comer is a fantastic professor and it has been a pleasure taking his OS class. The class has a large focus on studying principals, design decisions, tradeoffs, and the interaction of system components rather than memorization. The study of design and systems is applicable to much more than just OS's. We get hands on OS dev experience too.
Definitely the best professor I've had in Purdue's CS department. His lectures perfectly encapsulated all of the course materials, and were very clear and well paced.

One of the best professors in the Purdue CS Department. He does his best to give students hands on experience with operating systems, which is very useful to sharpen software engineering skillsets and practical knowledge.

One of the most fascinating professors in the CS department. He worked in silicon valley and helped create the internet. Has tons of interesting stories to tell. He cares about learning much more than grades -- class is enjoyable and low stress.

Douglas Comer teaches this course based on a book he wrote about the digital world. His lectures are very well explained and he is passionate about his content. Attendance is not mandatory but there is a quiz once a week during lecture. Regardless of the class he teaches, he is a great prof and knows how to make students understand content well.
like always, a great story-teller. insightful on the industry at large. lectures very close to the book because he wrote it. study the slides and do the projects, you'll be fine.

well, he wrote the book, so he followed it super closely....like he used the book as slides pretty much. *EXTREMELY* experienced in industry...that means he has a lot of stories to tell..like the history of IBM and why Microsoft is horrible. read the books and slides closely and you're good
He likes to make jokes about other people/companies
No Comments
No Comments

Prof. Conaway is an excellent teacher and an even better human being. He runs an efficient rehearsal and gives good, to-the-point feedback. He won't sugarcoat anything, but will give praise where it is deserved. 
If you have him as a teacher, take the time to talk with him. He gives great advice and is just fun to have a conversation with.

Professor Conaway is awesome as a band director, composer, and person as a whole. He made rehearsals engaging, making 110 minutes fly by. Music choice is subjective for everyone, but I liked his picks overall, even if they were not the most challenging. Would highly recommend spending at least a semester with him.
Very nice guy and excellent composer!

BAND 110- Marching Band He was very involved in his work. Wanted students to be well prepared. Very relatable as a person. I enjoyed hearing his comments. AMAZING COMPOSER! Never worked 1 on 1 with him.
Actually cares. Great professor, and fantastic human being. Relatable. Real.
She is awesome and teaches very well. Loved her classes.
In class work was hard to get done on time and the out of class project made my brain hurt.

Terrible waste of time. Was waiting for her to retire but had to take the class to graduate before she did. Hope the school hires someone who can teach this class in an experiential way not a "memorize what a data set is" way.
Really bad and waste of time, you can learn nothing from this class

There are lots of things in the exams that are not even in the slides, and the slides she gave us were oversimplified. The midterm would definitely tank your score. The midterms were so hard that they even made me cry. I DIDN'T EVEN CRY AT MY GRANNY'S FUNERAL WHO I GREW UP WITH, BUT I CRIED AFTER I TOOK THE MIDTERMS. She's nice, though.

The quizzes can be challenging, but other than that this is a great class. I found the final project very interesting and enjoyed being able to find information myself and not be forced to use made up info.

She is very energetic and passionate about her lectures. She is very fast-paced so I'd suggest doing the reading before the lecture, so you have a good understanding of the material. You get credit for going to class and she doesn't post the answers to the iClicker questions, so you need to be in class to get the correct answers.

Very big ego. The example questions have no answers on them, and I do not have enough storage to download every slide show and write the answer. She is also not very nice and likes to call people out.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Barely learned anything about audit.
Spent $180 on mandatory Mcgraw textbook and $80 on an audit case.
Class structure needs serious overhaul. 
Class is not test heavy but there are quizzes which are very different from what she covers in class.
Case content is interesting but challenging. She should create her own audit case though so it's free.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: awful

She is a pretty good teacher. Every class she provided extra credit for attending which helped grades. Lectures were relatively fun and she added humor, trying to make them relatable. She wanted everyone to pass so she would curve exam grades. Unfortunately, you had to pay for the book to do your homework which was quite expensive.

An absolute nightmare of a class.  Dropping $250 on a textbook and an incredibly difficult software to use wasn't fun.  The first half of the class was built around a horrible software that tanks your grade, and you have to build it back up in the second half with McGraw hill assignments.  Group work is tedious if your group sucks.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She's a really good lecturer, I wish I'd paid more attention in class. She knows her audience well and is accommodating to questions. Unfortunately, you have to pay to do your homework (like $170). It's worth most of your grade, which is nice. The exams are straightforward, just take notes!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This woman made me drop $250 for a class and doesn't teach well. If I had known what course 373 was, I would not have selected Purdue as my school. I regret taking this class, and everything she does is so convoluted. Her feedbacks are terrible and I hope to never take any of her classes that she makes.

Possibly the worst professor I have ever had at Purdue. She does not know how to teach a new course and does not care about anything. I hope she retires soon so that other students don't have to suffer what I went through. Her teaching at Purdue just sets the business school back a thousand years and it has become a waste of my tuition money.

Great and easy online course. The exams are a bit difficult, but as long as you do the homework you'll get a good grade for sure. There is a bit of homework for an 8 week summer course, but it is very easy and its through McGraw. Very caring and accommodating despite the accelerated learning environment. A great experience overall!

Professor Conroy is an awesome professor. The class is very easy, you just need to do ALL the homework, get average exam scores, and go to class(because if you go to class she has extra credit just for going and there is no limit on extra credit points). Not to mention there is a curve, which can further help your grade.
Paula is one of my favorite professors! Her in-class quizzes/activities are very helpful and she does a great job lecturing. Exams were fairly challenging but doable.

If you have to take MGMT 212 try to make sure you get Conroy. Her class is easy(even though accounting can be a headache) and if you want to get an A all you need to do is show up to class, as she gives EC at each lecture, do the homework and get 70+ percent on the exams. Also, she is very chill.

While this a newer class, Professor Conroy made the most of it testing out the structure of the course. It was set up as lecture (1st half of class) and a group in-class activity (2nd half of class). Sometimes, expectations for assignments and projects were sometimes vague, but overall great activities.

I highly recommend taking this class. As long as you do all the homework (which you can easily get a 100 on) and do average on the exam, you can get an A. Make sure you read through the textbook and memorize the vocabs. She also gives an extra credit point for every lectures you attend. Curves will also be given at the end of the semester.
She is very knowledgable but the content itself is hard. She is not the best at explaining things and it is hard to get help outside of class.
Great professor if you show up to class you will do really well

Paula makes her classes much harder than they have to be. She assigns tons of textbook reading, has lengthy assignments, and assigns exams that include very obscure questions. She has a very weird grading structure, with no curves until the end of the year. However, her lectures are entertaining and she gives out a lot of extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Paula is a really nice, smart, helpful, and funny professor. However, 351 is the most difficult course I have ever taken, but this is not her fault (intermediate 2 is generally the weed out). Exam averages were all below 60%, and she does not curve. But she gives out tons of extra credit (500 points possible and gives out 100 extra credit points).
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Easy class. Show up to lecture and you get a ton of extra credit just for showing up. She's smart, knows what she's talking about, and organized. She does a good job teaching. If you get all available extra credit in the course (which isn't that hard) and do all the homework, you can probably average a C on all exams and end the course with an A.

The last time to date I got an A+. She knew what she was talking about and made it easy for students to learn. Was a fall 2020 class so things might be different now, but exams were online with lockdown browser. Not horrid. Also let us to skip the final if we wanted to with the average of the other exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof. Conroy is a great lecturer and really tries to help her students. The Hotseat in class is helpful for the exams and to understand the concepts. There are numerous opportunities for extra credit. The homework and reading each week are quick and very self-explanatory. Overall a very low-stress class!

Extra credit is given every class. If you do all the homework and show up to class you are guaranteed to pass. She knows the people taking the class aren't accounting majors so she does her best to highlight basic skills that are actually important to life. She is very enthusiastic. Tests are more difficult than expected.
Didnt know how to explain differently, lecture were very bland
Professor was very understanding of personal life.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: the exams are tough, but it's possible to get a good grade without acing the exams. Hotseat was used in class and she gave out extra credit each lecture. This helped me a lot. Professor Conroy does a good job explaining material and for the most part does a good job helping you prepare for the exams.
The group projects are easy to do well on if you follow along with the instructions. The homework was completion based. Don't just use her review slides to study for exams, use all of her slides.

Paula was a very poor teacher. Her "lectures" used slides with many words/visuals that she would show for 20 seconds, never enough to take adequate notes. She would talk over each slide attempting to explain them, but it was hard enough to quickly type down the info, much less simultaneously process what she was saying.
Super great and easy class. All tests were open note online.
No comments. She is simply the best and makes this class VERY engaging. Would take this class again in a heartbeat.

Dr. Lim-Kessler is always very bubbly and her lectures are genuinely enjoyable. The class is easy. everything is online, homework is nonexistent, and there were only like 2 quizzes. She's very understanding too and let me make up an exam when I was sick once.

An absolutely amazing professor! Genuinely one of the sweetest and most caring people ever. For PSY201 she goes through all the homework for you, so as long as you come to class she will flat out give you the answers. All the quizzes/test were incredibly easy. Attendance not mandatory but honestly just go for her. Sweetest Prof Ever.

I really like Lim-Kessler's energy and I think she is super sweet, but her lectures didn't really add anything to the course. She kind of just reads off the slides and reiterates like she's making new points. I stopped going after about a week and still got an A by just reading the slides.

Professor Lim-Kessler is one of the kindest professors I have ever had. If students are confused she will take time to stop her lecture and thoroughly explain it again. She is a relatively easy grader and gives extensions if you have a valid reason. I would 100% take a class with her again.

She is an amazing teacher. This class can be hard if you do not go to lectures or read over the slides, but overall, it is easy. Tests and quizzes are taken online, and on days that you have tests/quizzes, there is no class. She loves this topic and wants her students to learn and do well.

She is such a great teacher. Many homework assignments, but she does the homework with you in class. Tests and quizzes are taken online, and on days you have tests/quizzes there is no class. She is so kind and caring. She gave us candy on Halloween, math-themed pencils, and erasers in different shapes.

Dr. Lim -Kessler is amazing. She is so sweet and is passionate about what she teaches. She is the most caring professor ever and every exam is open note and online. Attendance is not mandatory, but her lectures are enjoyable, so I recommend going. Sometimes she throws in some extra credit if you attend.
you don't really have to go to class

I absolutely loved her class! She very clearly cares about all of her students and she makes an effort to connect with everyone that comes to class. She occasionally also would give out extra credit to the students who attended class. Overall, she was a great professor!

She's an absolute sweetheart. She walks through the homework with us and really explains it in a way that is easy to understand. Her lectures were recorded, and her exams/quizzes were administered online. She was easy to reach outside of class. On the last day of class, she brought little gift bags for us all

Does all of the homework with you in class, at least for PSY 201 which makes life so much easier but also does make it harder to retain because I feel like I didn't have to try as hard. She's very sweet and tries very hard to make Psych statistics as easy as possible especially since it's super tough for some.

I absolutely love professor Lim-Kessler and this class was super easy. Attendance isn't required, her lectures are recorded and all the tests and quizzes are open note/open book. As long as you have the notes down, there's no reason you shouldn't get a great grade in the class. She really cares about her students and is always available to help.

I adored taking Psy 222 with Dr. Lim-Kessler. Although lecture slides were posted and she recorded lectures, I never skipped a class because of how much I loved her class. Even if the exams and quizzes weren't open notes, she makes the content so interesting and easy to learn I'd still do okay because she just explains things so well.
Prof Lim-Kessler is literally so amazing, she's so sweet and really cares about her students. She's also really passionate about the material and just overall a great professor.

Best professor I have ever had! I don't think one can ask for a better teacher!! She is the most caring teacher ever. She always checks up on people and understands that college is hard. I just cant say enough about how great she is. I recommend her to anyone who has the option of taking a class with her!

Professor Lim-Kessler is one of the kindest educators I have ever encountered. She is very passionate about behavioral neuroscience and just wants students to learn and do their best. All tests and quizzes are open note and pull information from the lectures and videos from class. She is the best and I'd love to take another one of her classes!

I have taken two courses with this professor and she is so great! She is caring about her students and will do her best to make the lectures easy to understand. In her Intro to statistics in psychology course she goes through the homework problems and makes them easy to understand. We had a book, but rarely used it.

Literally one of the best professors ever.  She is fantastic and super knowledgable.  She really cares about all of her students and makes complex math/ideas easy to understand.  I'm taking PSY222 this semester just to have her as a professor.  If you have an opportunity to take a class she teaches, do it.
Dr. Lim-Kessler really cared about her students learning and the class was very engaging if you are interested in the topics. She was also very sweet and always made me smile.

This is a very easy & interesting class. Even though attendance isn't mandatory, there are questions on exams from class discussion that are not included in her slides and you can get a bunch of extra credit for attending.
Dr. Lim-Kessler is amazing. I don't particularly enjoy stats, but she made the class bearable and easy to understand. She's very caring and personable as well.

I had Dr. Lim-Kessler for 201 and 222. She is an amazing professor who cares about her students. Even if I did not find the topic interesting, she made it fun. She is willing to help outside of class, and it is clear that her students love her. 

Try to take her for 201 if you can. I really struggle with math, but she made it understandable!

Fantastic class taught by a fantastic professor. The content was never too difficult to understand, the tests and assignments were straightforward, and lectures were informative and enjoyable. Would recommend taking this class.
Great professor, does a great job of going over work. Is also just an all around caring woman, made me smile every time I went to class.
I went to 4 classes the whole semester and got an A+. Not worth going very easy.
This professor is amazing!!! She always greeted everyone with a smile when you walked into lecture! I will miss having her as a professor so much!

Mrs. Kessler was one of the nicest teachers I've had at Purdue. You can tell how much she cares about you as a student and about her subject in every lecture. The test are open notes but she doesn't give you a lot of time to take the exam so you should still study before the exam. The homework was really easy and I felt like I learned a lot from it

I absolutely loved the professor! Her lectures were very detailed and she has been extremely helpful. I would frequently go to her office hours and she would always have satisfying answers. Would definitely recommend this class with this professor!

She is very understanding and she truly cares about her students' mental health which is simply amazing. The content is very interesting and she makes sure that her lectures are never boring. I would 100% take this class again and would love to have her for future courses. Hands down my favorite professor at Purdue.
Great professor! She is very sweet and caring and lectures are recorded so you don't have to show up to class. Her lectures are interesting and she is just really awesome as what she does.

SHE IS THE BEST PROFESSOR EVER. She is so sweet and understanding I had her for two difference PSY courses and both were very easy. She does a great job at explaining the material and making it fun and easy to understand. I would 1000% take another class of hers. She truly cares about her students and their mental health.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Absolutely loved working with this professor!

She is an amazing professor. You do have to go to class to be able to do well on the tests. Her assignments are pretty easy, and she gives you ample time to complete them. She cares about her students and is super approachable. Just make sure you go to class and take good notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Kessler gives informative lectures made more engaging by her quirky personality. I would recommend going to lectures in-person if possible because they feel quite homey - I definitely looked forward to them. The coursework was very manageable, and the weighting for grades is incredibly fair. Most importantly, she cares about her students!

I love Dr. Lim-Kessler  she is truly a gem at Purdue. She is super understanding, very clear in her lectures and just has really good energy. I cannot recommend her enough. I will say going to class is critical. The tests are online which is nice - but they're not an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Lim-Kessler was one of the most considerate professors I have had. When spring break was canceled, she added additional reading days for our class. The course work was very manageable and all of the exams were open note, and directly from the lectures. Dr. Lim-Kessler was incredibly engaging and made the class so fun and easy.

Dr. Lim-Kessler is a great professor! She's hilarious and really cares about her students. I took this class as a hybrid during COVID, so I just watched the recorded lectures on my own time. The exams are really easy if you fill out and study the lecture slides. She also responds to emails really quick; I would definitely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Lim-Kessler is so nice and helpful. She works hard to make the lecture material engaging and easy to take in. Her lecture slides are gold for the exams, but the exams still cover material from the book well. As long as you show up to lecture and fill in the notes, you'll do great.

Dr. Kessler is so sweet. She makes jokes throughout class and keeps it lighthearted. The course is very interesting and although it make look like a scary class to take on paper, it was a great choice.

Dr. Lim-Kessler is a super sweet lady and her lectures are always entertaining. At least for the summer with COVID, exams were open note, open book, and straight from the slides. Textbook is helpful but definitely not necessary. Best prof for PSY 120. Her class is easier than SOC100.

Dr. Lim-Kessler was great. Explains topics very well and often gives examples of things in order to make you understand topics better. Easiest class I've ever taken, easier than anything in high school even. Your grade relies on tests and writing assignments but both are very easy. Very personable teacher, would want her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: One of the sweetest teachers I have had. Need to go to lectures to be able to fill in the blanks but the test questions are taken directly from the notes. She makes lectures interesting.
Sweetest woman you will ever meet! Dr. Lim-Kessler really cares for her students and wants their success. Do not hesitate to reach out to her if you need help or have been ill.

The most wonderful human on this planet. She cares about her students and loves being a teacher. While the textbook was not a complete necessity, it was helpful. All the tests are based off her notes. The whole class in a lecture so you won't make any friends in the class but she knows her stuff. I would recommend taking her!

Dr. Lim-Kessler's Psy 222 class Intro to Behavior Neuroscience was one of my favorite classes yet. The content is fascinating. While Dr. Lim-Kessler does tend to just read off the slides, the content as I previously stated, is truly amazing. The book is very helpful, however not needed. I purchased the bool afterwords for joy reading.

I liked this class! The only grades are exams and homework, so make sure to study for exams. However, whats on the exams is taken directly from lectures. I would say do not buy the book, it will save you money. I have never used it. Definitely one of my easier courses this semester.

Prof. Lim-Kessler is so nice, amazing, and truly cares about her students and tries to know them. You're only graded on 3 tests and a final throughout the year, each worth 25%. Lectures are dense in material and not taught in depth, but exam questions are right off slides. Textbook isn't mandatory but useful if you don't understand something.

Only one of the greatest professors on Purdue's campus. Sweetest lady you will ever meet. If taking Psych 222000, make sure you show up to class to fill in blanks on notes. Make sure to study at least a week before exam because notes cover a lot of material.

Professor Kessler teaches a good class. For each chapter she would forward the students fill in the blank lecture slide notes. She read straight from the slides but also provided additional information and discussion upon those points. The only grades in the class were 4 exams& 2-3 extra credit points per exam. All exam q's were in notes. Nice lady

She's a great professor. This class is only exam grades so if you don't do well on one it's hard to get your grade up. Textbook isn't necessary but recommended and lecture is the same way. Her notes have blanks in them that you can only get if you go to class. She is really funny and tries to relate everything to modern times even if it doesn't.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very good lecturer!

Really nice and caring person. Her lectures were a un-pc sometimes and she used the Drs as a reference for videos a lot but overall she's a great professor and super sweet! She cares a lot about student input and changed her class to best fit our needs. Truly a caring and incredible prof! Only 4 exams so make sure you do well (no assignments)

Textbook isn't mandatory but it helps a lot! She gets off-topic a lot but she is one of my favorite professors in all of my time at Purdue (personality-wise). The class rubric only composed of the exams but she gave easy extra credit opportunities. Attendance isn't mandatory but you should go for notes since her lecture slides have blanks in them.

Possibly my favorite professor I've had at Purdue. She loves her students dearly and enjoys her subject. The second exam leans more into applying the ideas taught in class to problems than actually asking you to list something. iClicker is for extra credit and the projects are sometimes fun but require a several-hour lock-in. Fantastic professor.

I had a very positive experience in her class. She explains material clearly and creates a welcoming environment. Quizzes allow notecards, and exams permit a reference sheet, which helped me feel prepared. She encourages students to succeed and offers opportunities for extra credit. Overall, I found the course well-organized and supportive.

I passed STAT 113 with a B, but I would not recommend taking this class with this professor. Lectures were unclear, and exams differed greatly from lectures and practice exams, feeling more like a scare tactic than a fair test. The course needs clearer instruction, better alignment, and more support for new statistics students.
Great professor. Fun, easy class. Cheat sheets on exams. Projects were a lot of work, but fun. iClicker is required but not that bad. Great class

class is hard if you struggle in math calculations and good studying. The professor is great! there is iclicker which is annoying but if you have over 75% by the end of semester you dont have to keep going. projects are hard if you procrastinate. Must understand circuit or you'll lose easy points w peer reviews, must understand instructions clearly

Offered extra credit for lecture attendance, and lectures were helpful in completing homework. This class had an appropriate workload for the credit hours and 100-level: nothing very difficult. I was rushed for time on exams, but crib sheets were allowed on exams and quizzes. Also, Prof Crabill was good at communicating important information.

Posts all lectures online, making attending the lectures not as "important", the lectures make it super easy to study for the exams. Homework is a little hard to keep track of because the program doesn't show brightspace reminders. Recitation quizzes were always easy and helpful towards the exams
For my first online class at Purdue, it was really well-organized and I had zero problems. Some lectures, some projects, couple exams.
She is my favorite professor! She cares so much!
If you pay attention during lectures, all the info you'll need is there. It gives you the exact things you need for exams and recitation quizzes. Watered-down version of AP Stats.

Crabill is very nice but she will talk overtime on every lecture! That being said she allows cheat sheets for every quiz and exam so just write down terms, formulas, and things from lecture and you will be fine on the exams! There are a few online projects but nothing in groups. She uses lots of examples which help explain.

Mrs. Crabill has very clear and concise lectures, rarely talking about information that will not be gone over in exams. If she does do this, she always mentions what concepts you need to know. If you get a 75% or higher on iClickers, you get 3 extra credit points. Make sure to make cheat sheets for the exams because she encourages it.

Mrs. Crabill is an excellent professor and teaches very well. All of the lectures give you exactly what you'll need to do well on the recitation quizzes and exams. The projects are also simple enough and are great grade boosters. The course overall to me felt like an easier version of AP Stats, most people would have 0 problem, difficulty-wise.

I don't really know about the other professors, but Ms Crabill is definitely worth trying. She is a fantastic teacher, and the way she teaches is just so easy to understand. Her explanations are clear and engaging, and she always takes the time to ensure everyone is following along. I hope that I could write more but the app doesn't allow me to
Super informative, organized, and quick to respond. I took the asynch version, but it was relatively easy and her lectures were really helpful!

Prof. Crabill made statistics easy for me. She uses real world examples and provides homework that helps master content for almost weekly quizzes. She also provides a great opportunity for extra credit if you attend lecture! I can tell she loves teaching, and she is great at it!

The professor is amazing! She makes the class so interesting with real-life examples and I genuinely enjoyed all the lectures. Be careful to not forget that not only you have to do your project but also do peer review, I'd forgotten so many times, the only reason I got a B. If you like stats or even if you don't, this class is amazing!

Wonderful professor! I absolutely loved her class! She is so caring about all her students and very open to students about answering questions! I became so much more interested in Statistics after her course!

Cheryl has been a great professor and very lovely! She sends weekly briefing emails, provides opportunities for extra points using optional worksheets, and grading is on time and very organized. She is very friendly too. The exams for the online class are in person, but are fair and we get a cheat sheet too. The projects are fun and doable.

Overall a great professor. Makes lectures interesting and puts a lot of effort into them. She gives you plenty of resources to do well on the tests and projects, and allows for regrades on tests and other assignments. Getting an iclicker and showing up to class allows for easy extra credit. I enjoyed her class a lot and would totally take it again!

Cheryl is very accessible outside of class. She allows for regrades on exams and projects and 1 quiz 1hw/week . GET AN ICLICKER!!!! You can get up to an extra 3% on your final grade. Posts lectures online, I watched them before the quizzes and did very well. She made this course tolerable. I got a B cause I didn't study for the first exam.. oops.
She is so caring and kind to students. Offers lots of extra credit!! Prepares you well for the exams through the quizzes and homework.

Professor Crabill is very genuinely caring for all of her students and is an excellent professor. There is 1 homework assignment per week, 1 quiz every week, and only 2 exams, no final exam. She is a very fair grader, exam are very easy if you pay attention in class, and she offers extra credit through iClicker. Would definitely recommend!
This professor was amazing. She genuinely cared about the students and their knowledge being advanced from this class. She explained the material extremely well and is just a very kind person.
Made stats very enjoyable. If you go to class and take notes, you will do great!
Lectures are optional but are super helpful and you can get extra credit. She is super organized and a fair grader.

I read a review that said "tons of extra credit". That's one reason why I took this course. Tons turned out to be 3 points for class participation. I had not had any stat prior to this class. The projects are awesome. The homework is tough, but you can print with feedback a try again. 2 exams are hard. The course does make you think! Take it!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I had no prior knowledge about statistics going into this class; however, Professor Crabill's learning techniques and course structure helped me succeed with low effort. Go to lecture, prepare for the quiz in recitation, and do the homeworks and projects in a timely manner and you should be fine. Bonus points are offered for class participation.

Cheryl is awesome! She is extremely kind and passionate about what she does! Lectures were super easy to follow and she made class exciting by adding fun videos and examples. She was always available to help and eager to see us succeed! She also gave a ton of extra credit which helped boost my grade! Amazing lecturer and great course!

Took Marta for CS 177, and she was amazing. She was extremely accessible outside of class with basically 24/7 help available through all the TAs and herself. The labs have mandatory attendance but were the same as the prelab. Lecture videos were posted same day with the course participation being due at midnight that night.

Prof Crowe geniunlly cares about her students and wants us to do well. She's always willing to help outside of class and got an A with no effort even though I got C's on all the exams and knew nothing about excel

Marta is a great professor. Her lectures aren't mandatory, and you can always watch videos from class online. Labs are mandatory, but there is usually homework so it's a good time to get that done. A semester long group project takes up a big part of your grade, but it's nothing bad. Tests are long but as long as you did the HW you're fine.

I suppose this review doesn't matter since this is the last semester of CS235, BUT character-wise, she seems very nice, attendance was required, but you could do it on your own time (after class) as she posted lecture videos. I stopped attending mostly because she uses a mic to speak, and it was always popping. Seems nice, though!
Dense course, but she organizes it effectively and provides what you need to earn a good grade. Great for mastering Excel and teamwork.

Marta is a great professor. She is very clear in explaining things and wants her students to do genuinely well in her classes. The course was structured really well. It sucks that this is the last semester she is teaching this course. Overall, if you get her as a professor, you'll do well. Just make sure to do the work and ask questions.
she is okay prof
Its a merge class,so attendance is basically free.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The lectures are boring, but they are recorded. Nice person and very understanding. Exams are difficult, even if you take the time to study and take notes.

The class is super easy, and if not there are lots of resources to make sure you do well. You can do assignments as many times as you want until you get a 100%. The exams are also just like the labs and HW. The prof is very understanding and accommodating.

Class was a bit of work, but if you just get things done you can easily get an A in the class. Can rewatch lectures and redo every assignment except exams. To prep for exams, go to her reviews they are very similar to the test. For extra exam practice I just redid labs and lab preps. She is a nice lady and very helpful.

The class had a lot of homework, but as long as you pay attention in class you'll have a good foundation for all of the work that you do outside of the course participation. Prof Crowe is very sweet and very accessible outside of class. She is patient and is willing to work with you outside of class to make sure you are understanding the content.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great overall, the class was easy and if you have any questions, the TAs respond very quick, and you can even do zoom with them. Very helpful the grades are like this:LAB CPS: 5%, LAB PREPS: 10%,LABS:20%, EXAMS:35%, TEAM PROJETS:15% lecture CPS; 15%(She posts lectures onbrightspace so if you get caught up in something you don't have to go to class,
Crowe is the most caring professor I have ever had. I had never worked on Excel before and her class was super accommodating. She cares about her students better than any professor I have had.
She really cares, and is super easy to keep up with in class.

Marta was very caring and overall the class was extremely helpful, however I find it much more beneficial to watch the lecture recordings instead of attending lecture because she moves really fast and if you have a Mac it is more complicating. There's a group project that lasts the whole semester and it is sort of confusing but graded very easy.

Firstly, her voice is bad. The major reason why I do not go to her class is because of her voice. Her voice is too crying voice like sheep. And she speaks like shouting, Her lecture is too fast to catch up. There was nothing I learned in class. I learned myself through lab time.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Crowe does a great job of helping and explaining new topics, especially if you have had no experience with Excel before. Exams are fair, but packed with tons of work, so be sure to have everything perfected. Homeworks is easy and late credit is given if needed.

Such an amazing professor! She was also very clear on assignment due dates and requirements. She was always available during office hours if you needed help. Overall she really cares about her students and wants them to succeed. Amazing professor!

Professor Crowe was a good lecturer and was very caring for her students. There is a course participation due every lecture and lab. Some weeks can be work heavy if there's multiple chapters covered in lab, but overall, the content is very doable and there are many resources available if you are struggling.

I really enjoyed the class, just get organized before the class begins so you don't fall behind! The homework and labs are relatively easy, but the exams are a bit more difficult. Do the homework and labs on time and you'll be fine! The professor is super nice and really cares about her students.

Great teacher, class kinda hard but she's a great teacher, cares about her students, lots of office hours, and always willing to help after class. Class set up with in-class excel, lab excel (on own), lab prep (done in lab), weekly quiz with unlimited tries, &exams. Attendance mandatory for weekly lab but not class bc she uploads video.

There is course participation in every lecture but lectures are available online to watch. Recorded lectures are very nice to have because she sometimes goes through content very fast and you can get lost easily.

Professor Crowe is clearly passionate about what she teaches. She is always open to help whenever she can, and I wasn't afraid to ask her questions. There was a group project but it wasn't too difficult. You must buy the course manual but you are allowed to use it on exams and it is very helpful. Overall, super doable class.

This professor speaks so quickly in lectures that it not only creates a stressful environment for her students but means that they cannot fully comprehend the material. I never walked out of class feeling better than when I walked in.

Professor Crowe makes it easy to get a good grade in this class. She does a course participation every lecture, but posts videos so it's okay if you miss. Exams can be difficult but they are only 35% of your grade. Labs are beneficial and I recommend going every week. There's a group project throughout the semester, but it is graded very easily.

Class is taught at a really quick rate, and most of the students take notes outside of the course time because you spend most of the time doing the "Course Participations" (just like homework). The course is pretty difficult, there's a lot of material but straightforward exams if you do the work. Love this professor, she's really helpful and sweet!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: she a very teacher no cap

She is super nice and caring and an amazing professor. Lectures are not required but there are course participations that are apart of your grade. There is a decent amount of work each week but once you get the hang of the topics it goes by quickly. She and the TAs are helpful when confused about what you got wrong. There is a semester long project

Attendance is not mandatory, and lectures are posted online. The homework and labs can take a bit, but you get clear feedback, and multiple attempts. Exams are open note for any previous work and very similar to the exam practices. The professor does speed through course participation, but you can go back to the video later if needed.

reviews.comment: Incredibly caring and super understanding.  If you have questions outside of class she is always willing to help.  Labs have three submissions so you should get at least 95% on each one.  Labs are also extremely close to exams so studying wasn't hard to do.  The group project felt like a waste of time but it was incredibly easy.

She is a really nice professor who needs more time for her lectures. Pay attention in class because if you go into business you will be applying what you learn here a lot! Homework and group projects can be painful at times but it is not ridiculous. In the group project, the TAs WILL knock off points if you don't have an excel output.

Crowe is an amazing teacher and she is willing to answer any questions and help anytime she is in her office. There are many ways to get help on assignments and course materials. The class can be hard if you do not stay up with your materials/assignments.

Professor Crowe is fantastic and the class is very useful. Beware there's a sizable amount of homework, but not too difficult. Lots of opportunities for multiple submissions - homework/labs are very helpful. Tests only make up 35% of your grade; if you put in a decent amount of effort you'll get an A. Attendance not mandatory but recommend you go.

Lots of chances to try and retry assignments to get better grades. Prof Crowe records all lectures so if you miss a day or she moves to fast you can refer back to her lecture and work at your own pace.

Class has a lot of homework. Thing is, she's the only professor for this class, so if I can recommend one thing for the course... Do your homework, then go to class and lab. Exams are real easy if you do the homework, and the homework isn't that difficult, it's just busywork. Very little work outside of lab+class if you attend them.

The class is real easy. A few tricky things, but you get a course handbook that you're allowed to take notes in AND use on the tests. Lots of leniency built into the course, but there's lots of homework. The plus side is that the homework isn't very difficult, and it's got consistent due dates. Exams are hit or miss. Group project is not too awful.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: We do course participation each class, but she rushes so much that it is extremely hard to follow and is very frusterating. Labs are extremely helpful and 10/10 would recommend going all of them. The second exam is really tough, but TAs go back and regrade everyone's so you get a lot of points back.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Crowe was great. Beware- if you don't have a good project group, it might be harder to enjoy the class.
You can skip her class and still get an A. THERE ARE A TON OF EXTRA CREDIT

This class is largely self taught because of the format. You do the homework before the lectures however the lectures have participation points. There are labs with 3 group projects overall. She is very accessible outside of class and understanding of issues. She is very fair when admitting her mistakes as well as lenient for student mistakes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: The class is structured well and has a fair amount of homework. However, most of it you should be able to complete during your assigned lab period. I think class is very important and interesting. The hardest part of the class is the 3 group projects throughout the semester. They can take quite a bit of time. Should easily get an A.

Marta was very kind and helpful throughout the entirety of this course. My only problems were maybe the fact that she frequently had technical errors - and the only irony there is that its a CS class. However, even with these errors, we still learned the curriculum in a way that made sense and didnt feel like 12 hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Marta was a great instructor for the course. She was very caring and always willing to help students. Although the class was extremely easy, I was not a fan of the assignments. She gives a lot of busy work, and the group project is quite annoying. The excel application exams are very fast paced but only worth 15% of your grade total

Marta was a great instructor for the course. She was very caring and always willing to help students. Although the class was extremely easy, I was not a fan of the assignments. She gives a lot of busy work, and the group project is quite annoying. The excel application exams are very fast paced but only worth 15% of your grade total.
My favorite professor so far, would love to have her again.
